85c65cc2.title: Program Manager, AWS Developer Experience
85c65cc2.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you a strategic thinker who thrives on bringing order to complexity? Do you have a talent for orchestrating multiple projects while keeping stakeholders aligned and teams motivated? Can you translate big\-picture goals into actionable roadmaps that deliver results? If you're someone who combines organizational skills with leadership ability, we want to hear from you!  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Program Manager to join our team in India. In this role, you will be driving our most critical developer initiatives from conception to delivery. You will be navigating ambiguity, managing multiple workstreams working with stakeholders across all levels in the organization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead end\-to\-end program management of complex, cross\-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives and successful delivery
* Develop and maintain program plans, including timelines, dependencies, risks, and resource requirements
* Partner with senior leadership to define program strategy, success metrics, and key deliverables
* Drive effective stakeholder management across multiple business units, maintaining clear communication channels and managing expectations
* Monitor program budgets and resource allocation, ensuring efficient use of resources
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program delivery methods and team effectiveness

  

A day in the life  

Your morning may kick off with distributing status updates for major workstreams, highlighting key metrics, blockers, and upcoming milestones. You might then run a standup where you help the team resolve blockers, then pivot to writing the monthly business reviews gathering data points and ensuring your narrative communicates both successes and areas needing attention. In the afternoon you might lead a cross functional meetings to plan for an upcoming developer event.  

  

Throughout the day, you will maintain a balance between strategic thinking and hands\-on problem solving, ensuring both the big picture and daily details receive the attention they need.  

  

About the team  

The Developer Experience team's mission is to explore the future of development so that we can help developers navigate a path to that future. Our goal is inspire developers around the world. We show them how to practically use the new technologies to build efficiently in the cloud. We show them new things they are now able to achieve, both in tackling more complex cloud problems and building new solutions that leverage generative AI. We earn trust with developers by being authentic, and by being practitioners ourselves. We are on an exciting journey together, and not everything is solved yet.  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 4\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
* Experience managing or working within cross\-functional marketing and creative teams
* Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels
* Experience across affiliate marketing, PPC, SEM and social media advertising
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Technology management, or a related field
* 7\+ years of experience in program management, project management, or related fields
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, multi\-faceted programs in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences
* Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g., JIRA, Asana)
* Experience managing program budgets and resources

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in multi\-territory campaign management
* Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make data\-driven decisions
* Experience in vendor management and third\-party partnerships

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

18489ada.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
18489ada.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

 As a Sr Technical Program Manager, you will drive end\-to\-end program delivery, Agile transformation, and cross\-functional alignment across multiple teams and workstreams. This role requires strong execution leadership, deep SAFe expertise, and the ability to influence stakeholders while ensuring predictable, high\-quality delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead end\-to\-end program management for large\-scale, complex product development initiatives.
   

  

 Act as Lead Technical Program Manager / Release Train Engineer (RTE), driving execution across multiple Agile teams and workstreams.
   

  

 Facilitate and govern SAFe ceremonies (PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, Inspect \& Adapt, retrospectives), ensuring alignment and delivery predictability.
   

  

 Implement and strengthen Scaled Agile (SAFe) and Agile best practices, driving consistency across teams.
   

  

 Drive program\-level planning, execution, and delivery across scope, schedule, quality, and cost.
   

  

 Establish and track program metrics and KPIs (e.g., velocity, predictability, defect trends) to drive continuous improvement.
   

  

 Provide leadership and mentorship to Scrum Masters and Agile teams, reinforcing Agile, Lean, and XP principles.
   

  

 Ensure effective cross\-team coordination, managing dependencies, risks, and impediments across distributed teams.
   

  

 Maintain and communicate a clear view of program goals, delivery progress, and risks to leadership stakeholders.
   

  

 Drive initiatives to improve quality, automation, and defect management practices across the program.
   

  

 Foster a high\-trust, collaborative team environment focused on transparency, problem\-solving, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Support value stream planning, budgeting, and capacity management within a SAFe framework.
   

  

 Partner with business, product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure alignment with strategic priorities.
   

  

 Identify and escalate program\-level risks and issues, driving timely resolution.
   

  

 Recommend process improvements, policy enhancements, and strategic initiatives to improve delivery efficiency.
   

  

**All About You**
 Strong experience as a Technical Program Manager / Release Train Engineer in a SAFe Agile environment.
   

  

 Proven track record of managing large\-scale, cross\-functional programs involving multiple Agile teams.
   

  

 Deep understanding of SAFe principles, Agile methodologies, and Lean practices (certifications preferred).
   

  

 Hands\-on experience performing Scrum Master and Scrum of Scrums roles across complex programs.
   

  

 Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence, coach, and mentor teams without direct authority.
   

  

 Expertise in program metrics, reporting, and delivery governance.
   

  

 Strong understanding of project/program management fundamentals (scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk).
   

  

 Experience working with distributed teams, multiple stakeholders, and vendor partners.
   

  

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including leadership reporting.
   

  

 Proven ability to drive continuous improvement, process maturity, and organisational alignment.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills with a results\-oriented mindset.
   

  

 Ability to build a culture of accountability, transparency, and high performance.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 This role sits at the intersection of relationship management, strategy, and execution. You’ll work closely with Sales to drive long\-term partner growth and with internal teams to continuously improve the advertiser experience.
   

  

 This role is based in our Mumbai office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

* Have experience with data querying (e.g. SQL, advanced excel/GSheet)

00cd4254.description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE** 
 Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for financial risk management of banks and the financial services industry. We provide web\-based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents. We help more than 75\+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
   

  

* Attend client requirement discussions and understand business, functional, and solution needs.
* Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, workshops, and presentations for prospective customers.
* Prepare and submit responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other proposal\-related documentation.
* Prepare solution decks, product write\-ups, proposal content, business presentations, and customer\-facing collateral.
* Provide content support for certifications, ratings, analyst questionnaires, industry assessments, and related submissions.
* Work collaboratively with Field Sales, Sales Operations, Inside Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to support sales opportunities.
* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.
* Travel to customer locations for meetings, demonstrations, workshops, and business development activities as required


**Required Skills**
*Functional*
* Good understanding of banking and financial services industry.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities.
* Exposure to Treasury, ALM, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk, IRRBB, FTP, Basel II/III, Stress Testing, or related risk management areas is desirable.
* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.


**Other Essential Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, listening, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across multiple teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Flexible and positive approach to work with willingness to travel based on business requirements.


**Preferred Experience**
* Prior experience in software product pre\-sales, solution consulting, business consulting, or client\-facing product demonstrations.
* Prior exposure to Financial Risk Management products or banking product pre\-sales will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, fintech organizations, or enterprise software companies is preferred

The company’s commitment to innovation, customer\-centric approach, and deep industry expertise have established it as a trusted partner for enterprises worldwide. **About The Role**
 HCLTech is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Google Cloud Solutions Engineer / Architect to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in driving solution design and engineering efforts aimed at accelerating the adoption of Google Cloud at an enterprise level. As a Solutions Engineer / Architect, you will collaborate closely with global sales teams, technical architects, and industry stakeholders to craft innovative cloud solutions tailored to client needs. Your expertise will enable Fortune 2000 clients to migrate, modernize, and leverage data and AI\-driven automation solutions on Google Cloud platform, thereby transforming their IT operations and business processes.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields, with a minimum of 5 to 7 years of overall IT experience. At least 2\-3 years of hands\-on experience working specifically with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is essential. Technical proficiency in GCP compute, storage, networking, and data engineering tools such as BigQuery and Looker is required. Familiarity with AI/ML platforms like Vertex AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) is highly desirable. Candidates should also have experience working with global system integrator (GSI) partners and a solid understanding of industry\-specific value stream use cases, especially in domains like BFSI, retail, healthcare, telecom, manufacturing, or technology. Certifications such as Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect, Data Engineer, or Machine Learning Engineer are preferred.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Pre\-Sales \& Go\-To\-Market (GTM):**
* Collaborate with global sales teams and Google Cloud Architects to respond to RFIs and RFPs, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and business objectives.
* Develop ROI models and hyperscale funding strategies that demonstrate TCO benefits of Google Cloud solutions.
* Design industry\-specific use cases and ideation sessions focused on cloud adoption, modernization, and managed services.


**Cloud Architecture \& Solutions Engineering**
* Lead technical workshops and create reference architectures for data center migration and modernization projects on Google Cloud.
* Design and develop Google Cloud native applications and enterprise\-grade data engineering stacks utilizing BigQuery, Looker, and Vertex AI.
* Innovate and design AI solutions such as Gemini Enterprise Agentic AI and Generative AI (GenAI) to address enterprise needs, enhancing IT managed services and cloud operations.


**Partner Collaboration**
* Work collaboratively with GSI partners to build joint solutions, scale go\-to\-market strategies, and expand solution footprints.
* Leverage industry domain expertise to map value stream use cases across sectors such as BFSI, RCPG, telecom, healthcare, and manufacturing.


 In this role, you will be responsible for translating complex technical concepts into business value propositions, facilitating client engagements, and ensuring the successful delivery of cloud solutions that meet enterprise needs.
   

  

**Benefits**
 HCLTech offers a competitive benefits package that includes comprehensive health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. Employees have access to ongoing training and professional development opportunities to enhance their skills and career growth. The company fosters an inclusive and collaborative work environment, encouraging innovation and diversity. Additionally, employees can benefit from flexible working arrangements, cutting\-edge technology tools, and participation in global projects that provide exposure to the latest industry trends and practices.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 HCLTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to innovate and serve our clients effectively. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status, and we are dedicated to providing a workplace where everyone can thrive and succeed.

7747c672.title: Data Architect
7747c672.description:
**About Advanced Energy**
Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: AEIS), enables design breakthroughs and drives growth for leading semiconductor and industrial customers. Our precision power and control technologies, along with our applications know\-how, inspire close partnerships and innovation in thin\-film and industrial manufacturing. We are proud of our rich heritage, award\-winning technologies, and we value the talents and contributions of all Advanced Energy's employees worldwide.  

**Position Summary**  

The Data Architect is a highly skilled data professional responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable data architecture solutions that support enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives. Working within established enterprise architecture standards, this role translates business and technical requirements into practical data solutions that enable trusted, accessible, and high\-quality data across the organization.  

The Data Architect partners with business stakeholders, Data Product Managers, data engineers, and analytics teams to design and optimize data pipelines, data models, integrations, and analytical platforms. This role applies advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills to resolve complex data challenges, improve data accessibility and quality, and support the successful delivery of data and analytics initiatives.  

The position operates independently on complex assignments, contributes to larger transformation programs, and may lead small projects or data architecture workstreams.  

**Key Responsibilities**  

* **Data Solution Architecture**


* Design scalable and maintainable data architecture solutions aligned with enterprise standards, business requirements, and analytics objectives.
* Translate business and functional requirements into logical and physical data models.
* Develop architecture approaches for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption across cloud and on\-premise environments.
* Evaluate existing data environments and recommend improvements to support performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  

* **D****ata Integration \& Engineering Support**


* Design and support data integration solutions for SAP ECC, SAP BW, SAP S/4HANA, and other enterprise systems.
* Define data movement, transformation, and integration approaches using Azure\-based technologies.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to implement ETL/ELT frameworks and reusable design patterns.
* Support performance tuning and optimization of data pipelines and processing workloads.
  

* **Data Modeling \& Analytics Enablement**


* Develop logical, conceptual, and physical data models that support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases.
* Design Lakehouse and modern data platform structures consistent with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Partner with analytics teams to ensure data structures effectively support Power BI and other reporting solutions.
* Recommend improvements to data accessibility, usability, and reporting effectiveness**.**
  

* **Data Governance \& Quality**


* Support enterprise data governance initiatives by incorporating data quality, lineage, metadata, and security requirements into solution designs.
* Collaborate with governance teams to promote data standards and best practices.
* Help identify and resolve data quality issues through effective architecture and design approaches.
* Ensure compliance with established security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  

* **Stakeholder Collaboration**


* Partner with business stakeholders, Data Product Managers, and technical teams to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
* Communicate architecture concepts and technical recommendations to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Provide guidance and consultation on data architecture best practices and solution alternatives.
* Build strong working relationships across global and cross\-functional teams.
  

* **Project Leadership \& Continuous Improvement**


* Lead data architecture activities for small projects or defined workstreams within larger transformation initiatives.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical decision\-making processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve data platform capabilities, development practices, and operational efficiency.
* Stay current with emerging technologies, cloud data platforms, and industry best practices**.**
  

**Required Skills \& Technical Expertise**
**Essential**
* Strong understanding of data architecture principles, data modeling techniques, and data integration methodologies.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud\-based data solutions within Azure environments.
* Hands\-on experience with
* Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL)
* Azure Data Factory (ADF)
* Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2\)
* Power BI
* Knowledge of ETL/ELT design and implementation methodologies.
* Experience with data warehousing, Lakehouse architecture, and modern analytics platforms.
* Strong SQL development and performance optimization skills.
* Familiarity with SAP data structures and source systems including SAP ECC, SAP BW, and SAP S/4HANA.
* Ability to analyze and resolve complex data and integration challenges
  

**Experience**
**Essential**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline and **5\+ years of relevant experience**, OR
* Minimum of **5 years of experience** in data architecture, data engineering, analytics platforms, or related data management disciplines.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise data solutions supporting reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in cross\-functional project teams and collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SAP extraction technologies including CDS Views, ODP, OData, or SAP Extractors.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or similar data governance solutions.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Synapse Analytics, or other cloud data platforms.
* Domain knowledge in Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, or Commercial Operations.
* Professional certifications related to Azure Data, Databricks, SAP Data \& Analytics, or Data Architecture.
  

**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently on complex assignments with limited supervision.
* Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Collaborative approach with a focus on practical and business\-oriented solutions.
* Continuous learning mindset and commitment to technology innovation.
  

**Work Environment**
* Works in a standard office environment utilizing standard office equipment.
* Collaborates with global and cross\-functional teams.
* Works both independently and as part of a project team.
* May occasionally work outside standard business hours to support project requirements.
* Domestic and international travel may be required based on business needs.

bc56dd43.title: Program Manager, AWS Developer Experience
bc56dd43.description:
**Description**
 Are you a strategic thinker who thrives on bringing order to complexity? Do you have a talent for orchestrating multiple projects while keeping stakeholders aligned and teams motivated? Can you translate big\-picture goals into actionable roadmaps that deliver results? If you're someone who combines organizational skills with leadership ability, we want to hear from you!
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Program Manager to join our team in India. In this role, you will be driving our most critical developer initiatives from conception to delivery. You will be navigating ambiguity, managing multiple workstreams working with stakeholders across all levels in the organization.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end program management of complex, cross\-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives and successful delivery
* Develop and maintain program plans, including timelines, dependencies, risks, and resource requirements
* Partner with senior leadership to define program strategy, success metrics, and key deliverables
* Drive effective stakeholder management across multiple business units, maintaining clear communication channels and managing expectations
* Monitor program budgets and resource allocation, ensuring efficient use of resources
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program delivery methods and team effectiveness


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning may kick off with distributing status updates for major workstreams, highlighting key metrics, blockers, and upcoming milestones. You might then run a standup where you help the team resolve blockers, then pivot to writing the monthly business reviews gathering data points and ensuring your narrative communicates both successes and areas needing attention. In the afternoon you might lead a cross functional meetings to plan for an upcoming developer event.
   

  

 Throughout the day, you will maintain a balance between strategic thinking and hands\-on problem solving, ensuring both the big picture and daily details receive the attention they need.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Developer Experience team's mission is to explore the future of development so that we can help developers navigate a path to that future. Our goal is inspire developers around the world. We show them how to practically use the new technologies to build efficiently in the cloud. We show them new things they are now able to achieve, both in tackling more complex cloud problems and building new solutions that leverage generative AI. We earn trust with developers by being authentic, and by being practitioners ourselves. We are on an exciting journey together, and not everything is solved yet.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of professional non\-internship marketing experience
* Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
* Experience managing or working within cross\-functional marketing and creative teams
* Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels
* Experience across affiliate marketing, PPC, SEM and social media advertising
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Technology management, or a related field
* 7\+ years of experience in program management, project management, or related fields
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex, multi\-faceted programs in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences
* Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g., JIRA, Asana)
* Experience managing program budgets and resources


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in multi\-territory campaign management
* Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make data\-driven decisions
* Experience in vendor management and third\-party partnerships


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 \- AWS India \- Karnataka

As a SCADA Architect, you will be a key contributor to the development of next\-generation Control \& Protection HVDC and FACTS systems. You will design and implement holistic SCADA and communication architectures, including HMI visualization and communication functionalities, in a technically challenging environment. Your role bridges the gap between system\-level concept creation and hands\-on engineering, ensuring robust, modular, scalable, and innovative SCADA solutions for critical infrastructure projects.

**How You'll Make an Impact (Gas Turbine, R\& D , India)**

* Be part of the Operation Level Software Team within the Grid Flow Platform development, with a focus on R\&D activities.
* Design holistic SCADA system architectures for critical infrastructure HVDC and FACTS platforms, including HMI components, communication gateways, and monitoring functionalities.
* Interpret abstract requirements and translate them into system\-level requirement and operational concept specifications.
* Work hand\-in\-hand with IT, IT\-Security, Communication Network, and Control architects to incorporate Security by Design for innovative, distributed SCADA systems with multiple stations and subunits.
* Act as a crucial stakeholder in plant data modelling for device setup and deployment, and in signal management within the data\-driven engineering process framework.
* Support the full development lifecycle – requirements engineering, concept creation, implementation, testing, and project delivery.
* Act as the technical interface between R\&D projects, customer project execution teams, and development teams.

**What You Bring**

* Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience in complex SCADA system development, involving (but not limited to) Copa Data Zenon, WinCC OA, SICAM SCC (WinCC Classic), IPCOMM Protocol Converter, or comparable platforms.
* Strong understanding of communication protocols – IEC 61850, IEC 60870\-5\-101/104, OPC UA, DNP3 – along with data modelling in database structures.
* Solid knowledge of network communication protocols (IPv4, TCP/UDP).
* Experience in technical project management and cross\-functional coordination.
* Analytical mindset with a proactive, solution\-oriented approach.
* Fluent in English. German is an added advantage.

**Nice to Have**

* Domain knowledge of HVDC and FACTS station types.
* Familiarity with version control (GIT) and CI/CD deployment tooling.
* Experience with Linux and Windows operating systems (CLI and GUI).

**About the Team(Grid Technologies)**


Our Grid Technologies division develops and delivers products, solutions, and services for the reliable, sustainable, and digital transmission grid – including HVDC and FACTS systems that enable long\-distance power transmission and grid stability. Joining this team means contributing directly to the energy transition and to some of the industry's most technically demanding infrastructure projects.

**Who is Siemens Energy India?**


Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most\-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state\-of\-the\-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.


SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens\-energy\-india.com


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**


Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by \#TeamPurpleIndia. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  


**Job Description**



Are you ready to shape the next generation of enterprise automation while keeping mission\-critical workflows running smoothly?



As Tech Lead for the Automation Team, you will play a pivotal role in Husky’s transition from legacy workflow platforms to a modern, scalable automation landscape centered on the Microsoft Power Platform. You’ll lead by example—guiding your team in designing, governing, and delivering Power Apps and Power Automate solutions—while also ensuring the reliability, continuity, and evolution of existing automation solutions such as K2\.



This role sits at the intersection of innovation and responsibility: driving modernization, setting technical standards, and mentoring engineers, while safeguarding the automation backbone that supports our global business operations.



If you enjoy combining hands\-on technical leadership, platform thinking, and pragmatic enterprise automation, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.


**Responsibilities**


**Technical Leadership**


* Understand the E2E high level architecture (big picture)
* Translate the HLD (high level design) into the LLD (low level design) in collaboration with architects and own the LLD
* Technical direction for the product area
* Contribute to coordinating cross\-team dependencies and integration points


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Contribute to the feature definition and review
* Generate concepts and facilitate the concept selection
* Breaking down complex features into actionable tasks
* Helping with estimation and sprint planning
* Addressing technical impediments
* Own production readiness (incl. non\-functional requirements)


**Quality, Governance \& Security**


* Ensuring quality
* Conducting meaningful reviews and ensuring adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) / DoD (Definition of Done) criteria
* Ensure adherence to applicable standards, policies, and practices (e.g. DevSecOps)


**Incident Response**


* Leading incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post\-mortems


**Mentorship \& Team Growth**


* Mentoring team members
* Documenting key design decisions
* Participate in interviews and hiring decisions
* Promoting engineering best practices and driving continuous improvement


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Act as the primary technical point of contact across Product, Architecture, and Platform teams
* Clearly communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 10\+ years professional experience in software development, 5\+ years’ experience with Power Platform
* **Power Platform Expertise**
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including: Power Apps (Canvas \& Model Driven)
* Power Automate (cloud flows, approvals, error handling)
* Dataverse (data modeling, security, performance)
* Proven ability to design enterprise\-scale Power Platform solutions
* Strong understanding of solution layering, Application Lifecycle Management, and environment strategies
* **Power Platform Governance**
* Hands\-on experience implementing Power Platform governance, including DLP policies, environment strategies, Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit
* Strong understanding of: Role\-based security in Dataverse
* Tenant\-level Power Platform administration
* Experience working in regulated or enterprise environments (e.g., GDPR, ISO, SOC)
* **Azure \& Microsoft Ecosystem**
* Solid experience in integrating Power Platform with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Entra AD) and Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive)
* Experience with authentication and authorization: Entra AD, OAuth, service principals, managed identities
* **DevOps \& ALM**
* Proven experience with Power Platform ALM, including: Managed vs unmanaged solutions
* Versioning and deployment strategies
* **Experience with:**
* Azure DevOps or GitHub
* CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform
* Automated testing strategies (where applicable)
* Familiarity with source control best practices for low\-code assets
* **Development \& Customization Skills**
* Strong proficiency in: Power Fx
* JavaScript (for model\-driven apps)
* Understanding data modeling best practices and normalization
* Experience working with web services / APIs (e.g., SOAP, REST)
* Working knowledge of Agile development practices
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team
* Fluency in English (spoken and written)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities


**Assets**


* K2 Five / K2 BlackPearl – Workflows, Smart Objects, Forms and Views, Administration \& Troubleshooting, End\-to\-End testing
* Certifications: PL 600 \- Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
* Experience setting up or running a Power Platform Center of Excellence
* Prior experience in citizen development enablement
* Exposure to AI Builder, Copilot Studio, or Power Platform \+ AI scenarios
* Background in enterprise integration


**Why Husky?**


**Regulated Working Hours:** Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work\-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well\-being.


**Visible Impact:** Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.


**Strategic Influence:** Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.


**Empowered Involvement:** Take an active role in decision\-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.


**Valued Contributions:** Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.


**Impactful Role:** Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.


**Cutting\-Edge Projects:** Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer’s business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements.


**Supportive Community:** Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.


**Collaborative Environment:** Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success.

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. ac20a508.title: Solution Architect
ac20a508.description:
Join us as a Solution Architect at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Solution Architect , you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Experience in designing solutions for Core Banking, API Gateway, Client Onboarding, Orchestration ,integration, Channels, UX etc.
* Considerable workflow design knowledge across lifecycle status, exceptions, audit trails, service\-level agreements, and monitoring.
* Experience in modernizing legacy platforms with reusable services, integration contracts, data models, clear migration paths.
* Familiarity with AI patterns such as extractions, summarization, semantic search, workflow assistance, routing, triage, recommendations and human\-in\-the\-loop review.
* Ability to explain architecture through diagrams, proof\-of\-concept findings, trade\-offs, non\-functional requirements and implementation guidance, direct experience with Java, Microservices, rest API’s, event driven architecture, cloud container platforms, CI/CD. observability, resiliency, scalability and performance.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Domain Exposure to Banking.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Bengaluru.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

520c3873.title: Process Architect, Professional Services
520c3873.description:
**Process Architect, Professional Services**

**Executive Summary**


Blackbaud is seeking a Process Architect to design, standardize, and continuously improve end\-to\-end delivery processes across Professional Services. This role will strengthen operating models, clarify process flows, and define ownership structures that enable scalable, consistent, and high\-quality service delivery across our global workforce. The Process Architect will partner across teams to improve efficiency, reduce complexity, and protect the customer experience as the organization evolves.

**Role Summary**


The Process Architect is responsible for improving how Professional Services work gets planned, routed, delivered, and supported across teams. This role focuses on simplifying processes, clarifying how work moves through the organization, and helping teams adopt consistent practices that improve efficiency, collaboration, and customer experience.

**Operating Model \& Process Design**

* Define end\-to\-end service delivery processes across implementation, optimization, and managed services
* Create standardized workflow playbooks and process maps
* Establish clear handoffs across teams
**Front Office vs Back Office Segmentation**

* Define responsibilities between customer\-facing and non\-customer\-facing roles
* Eliminate role duplication and ambiguity
* Partner with leadership to evolve role definitions
**Global Workforce****Enablement**

* Identify work suitable for different global teams
* Design transition and ramp plans
* Partner with Global leadership to ensure readiness and quality
**Process Governance \& Quality**

* Define KPIs including cycle time, quality, and customer impact
* Establish governance models across global teams
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives
**Capacity \& Flow Optimization**

* Design workflows to balance global workloads
* Reduce bottlenecks and inefficiencies
* Define intake and routing processes
**Automation \& AI Enablement**

* Identify repeatable activities and manual handoffs that can be streamlined through automation or AI\-supported workflows
* Partner with operations, enablement, technology, PMO, RMO and delivery leaders to pilot scalable automation opportunities
* Translate process insights into practical AI use cases that improve quality, speed, consistency, and consultant experience
* Ensure automation supports customer experience, delivery quality, and responsible adoption practices
**Change Management \& Adoption**

* Partner with the PMO to drive adoption of new processes
* Partner with enablement for training
* Act as liaison between strategy and execution
  

**Required Qualifications**

* 8\-12 years in Professional Services, Consulting, or Operations
* Experience designing scalable delivery processes
* Experience with global delivery models
* Strong stakeholder influence and communication abilities
* The role is based in Hyderabad and is on a “blended”/afternoon shift (1\-10pm IST).
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with India\-based teams
* Familiarity with PSA tools
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or BPM frameworks
* Experience in SaaS or nonprofit technology environments
**Success Metrics**

* Successful transition of delivery work to global teams
* Improved process consistency
* Reduced delivery cycle time
* Standardized workflows with reduced escalation points
* Balanced utilization across teams
* Maintained or improved customer satisfaction

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube  



Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our *Intelligence for Good®* vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

  

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for an experienced and people\-focused **HR Program Manager** to design, develop, implement, and evaluate HR programs and initiatives across areas such as recruiting, employee engagement, and wellness. In this role, you'll lead the strategic planning and execution of complex HR programs while building meaningful partnerships — both internally and externally — that position Hyland as a premier technology employer in the community.


This is a role for someone who combines **strategic thinking with a bias for action**, thrives in a fast\-paced and ever\-evolving environment, and is genuinely passionate about delivering HR programs that make a difference for employees and the organization.

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**

* Microsoft Office

**Role Essentials**
-------------------

* **Strong oral and written communication skills** with a professional demeanor; excellent organizational, detail orientation, and interpersonal skills, with strong conflict management and negotiation abilities.
* **Proven ability to cultivate strong partnerships** and communicate and influence at all levels of the organization, with demonstrated ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and tact.
* **Self\-motivated with high energy** and an engaging level of enthusiasm; bias for action, strong work ethic, and desire to achieve excellence; proficient with Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office; up to 10% travel time required.

**What We'd Like to See**
-------------------------

* **Passion to learn about HR solutions and process improvement**, with the ability to propose and implement new initiatives aligned to market trends and competitive best practices.
* **Strong internal and external customer service focus**, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while remaining firmly results\-oriented.

**About Hyland**

Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation.

0a42333c.title: Staff Program Manager – Expert Readiness & Engagement (India)
0a42333c.description:
**Overview**
------------


At Intuit, our global network of thousands of tax, bookkeeping, and financial experts is the human intelligence (HI) that powers our AI\-driven financial technology platform. This position is a critical regional leadership role within Intuit's Expert Network, focused on the expert brand, operational readiness, change management, and engagement of our India\-based expert community.

  

As the Staff Program Manager of Expert Readiness \& Engagement (India), you will serve as the essential connective tissue between our global product/experience strategies and our local Indian expert footprint. Your mission is to ensure that when new technology, workflows, or product updates are introduced, the India network is 100% prepared to execute flawlessly. You will focus inward — architecting site branding, driving localized engagement strategies, managing internal communication, and leading regional change management frameworks. By leveraging continuous listening loops, you will ensure our India expert community is trained, equipped, and culturally aligned to deliver delight to our global customers.

 **Responsibilities**

*Lead Regional Change Management \& Expert Readiness*

* Deployment Orchestration: Act as the strategic partner to central expert readiness and change management and corresponding COEs for global tool deployments and product releases. Own the regional readiness roadmap for India, mapping out dependencies, training timelines, and process variations
* Impact \& Friction Assessment: Conduct change impact assessments to understand how global platform updates uniquely affect the Indian workforce. Identify and mitigate potential operational risks before deployment
* Adoption Tracking \& Hypercare: Define and monitor tool adoption metrics. Lead post\-launch "hypercare" support structures locally to quickly address technical glitches or operational confusion during critical peak seasons

*Establish Local Listening Infrastructure \& Process Rigor*

* Gemba \& Observational Studies: Establish a disciplined cadence of "Gemba" walks and workflow shadowing to observe real\-time tool usage, capturing friction points that quantitative metrics might miss
* Continuous Feedback Loops: Set up regional listening posts and pulse\-survey frameworks tailored to capture the daily sentiment, technical health, and overall tools readiness of the India network
* Insights\-to\-Action Root Cause Analysis: Partner with the global Expert Voice \& Insights team to translate local workflow friction into structured, data\-backed business requirements for the core product engineering backlog

*Drive Internal Engagement, Site Experience, and Communications*

  

* Strategic Communication Alignment: Manage regional internal communication channels, translating complex technical rollouts and global updates into clear, actionable, and culturally contextualized narratives for our experts
* Site Identity \& Brand Advocacy: Partner with local facilities and global creative stakeholders to guide physical and virtual site branding, creating a workplace environment that fosters deep brand pride and a unified mission
* Culture of Excellence: Design and scale localized engagement initiatives that boost community belonging, maintain high engagement scores, and celebrate "magic moments" where experts leverage AI to delight customers

 **Qualifications**

*Experience \& Change Management Domain Expertise*

* 8–10\+ years of experience leading Program Management, Change Management, or Operational Excellence initiatives within a global technology company or a highly scaled Global Capability Center (GCC) in India
* Change Management Frameworks: Direct expertise applying structured change methodologies; Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) or equivalent credentials preferred
* Rollout Architecture: Proven history of successfully landing complex, multi\-stakeholder software migrations or tool deployments across a large workforce of distributed users
* Operational Listening: Deep familiarity with setting up workforce feedback loops, executing Gemba\-style observational studies, and parsing qualitative feedback into structured data

*Leadership \& Influence*

  

* Cross\-Border Autonomy: Exceptional ability to operate as a self\-driven regional anchor, managing local delivery while maintaining matrixed alignment with a global cross\-functional team in the US
* Stakeholder Management: Strong capability to navigate tension between global tech timelines and local operational realities, advocating fiercely for the expert experience while respecting product launch goals
* Strategic Communications: Elite verbal, written, and presentation skills with a demonstrated ability to synthesize highly technical changes into intuitive, empathetic workforce communications

  

Footer
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

956e19e6.title: Senior Solution Architect (Azure)
956e19e6.description:
We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to lead the technical design of a real\-time, transaction\-heavy marketplace platform. The system involves live bidding and competitive pricing, multi\-region financial and tax logic, fraud prevention, and strict data privacy separation across user roles. This is a role of significant scope: the successful candidate will own both the platform's architecture and its security design, as these two disciplines are inseparable at this level of complexity. Candidates should bring deep cloud architecture expertise alongside practical, hands\-on security engineering experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end Azure architecture across a phased build roadmap, from foundational infrastructure through to a hardened, production\-scale system
* Design a large, interconnected data model with a strong focus on scalability, consistency, and long\-term auditability
* Architect systems with real\-time or near\-real\-time requirements, including concurrent request handling, live data synchronization, and state consistency under load
* Define clear service boundaries between core application logic, AI/ML\-driven components, payment processing, and fraud/risk detection, ensuring each can scale and fail independently
* Evaluate build\-versus\-buy decisions for third\-party integrations, including payment processing, tax calculation, and identity verification providers, and design abstraction layers that allow providers to be replaced with minimal rework
* Design for multi\-region regulatory compliance \- including tax, licensing, and eligibility rules \- at the data\-model level rather than through hardcoded, single\-region logic
* Design identity and data segregation architecture to ensure personally identifiable information remains fully isolated from public\-facing data, with no possible leakage paths
* Architect detection systems for policy violations and platform abuse, feeding into an automated enforcement and escalation framework
* Define the security posture for sensitive financial data, including encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management (e.g., Azure Key Vault), and compliance\-relevant boundary design
* Own the platform's audit and logging strategy, ensuring every automated action is independently traceable, given that enforcement decisions may carry legal implications
* Conduct threat modeling for the platform's highest\-risk workflows, particularly real\-time transactions, payment flows, and AI\-driven decisioning
* Define access control policy (Azure AD B2C, RBAC) for both end users and internal stakeholders with visibility into the environment
* Determine where AI/LLM\-driven decisions require mandatory human review versus full automation
* Produce phased technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, module\-level specifications, and a clear delineation between MVP and hardening\-phase scope
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for client stakeholders, translating business requirements into engineering decisions and communicating technical risk clearly
* Provide architectural mentorship and guidance to full\-stack developers, AI/ML engineers, and DevOps engineers throughout the engagement
* Participate directly in client scoping discussions, particularly where requirements are ambiguous or unresolved



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Cloud \& Architecture** 



* Demonstrated hands\-on expertise with Microsoft Azure, including App Service / AKS, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, SignalR, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure AD B2C
* Proven experience architecting systems with real\-time or near\-real\-time requirements, such as auction platforms, trading systems, or live collaboration tools
* Strong command of event\-driven and microservices architecture patterns
* Experience integrating third\-party payment processors and tax calculation engines into production systems



**Security Engineering** 



* Practical experience in application security architecture, including threat modeling, secure\-by\-design principles, and OWASP\-level best practices \- beyond compliance\-only exposure
* Experience designing PII segregation and anonymization architectures
* Familiarity with fraud detection system design, whether rules\-based, ML\-assisted, or hybrid
* Working knowledge of financial and marketplace compliance fundamentals, including payment facilitation structures, PCI\-DSS boundaries, and multi\-jurisdiction tax handling



**Domain Experience** 



* Prior experience on marketplace, e\-commerce, or fintech\-adjacent platforms strongly preferred
* Experience working with AI/LLM\-integrated systems and defining human\-in\-the\-loop review boundaries



**Professional Skills** 



* Strong client\-facing communication skills, with the ability to translate complex architectural trade\-offs into clear, non\-technical language
* Rigorous documentation discipline, with the ability to work cleanly against detailed, structured specifications



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience with bidding, auction, or dynamic\-pricing platforms
* Experience architecting systems delivered on compressed timelines without compromising security fundamentals
* Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or a recognized security certification (e.g., CISSP, OSCP)

* Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud environments

* Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to support application deployment and infrastructure needs

* Troubleshoot infrastructure issues and implement corrective actions
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery processes

* Cloud infrastructure and architecture

As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next\-generation, life\-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.

You will strengthen portfolio governance, improve project data quality and transparency, and enable timely leadership decisions on priorities, resources, risks and trade\-offs. This role will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Software, Cybersecurity, Service, Operations and external partners to translate the IDC project roadmap into well\-governed, well\-executed programs.
   

  

 This position reports to the Director of LBS IDC and will work closely with local and global stakeholders across the Leica Biosystems organization. The role is based on site at Leica Biosystems IDC, Bangalore.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Lead and mature the IDC PMO functions by establishing governance routines, standard work, execution cadence, templates, metrics and escalation paths that improve delivery discipline and accountability.
* Drive portfolio execution across NPD, sustaining engineering, lifecycle management, change requests and strategic site initiatives by aligning priorities, milestones, dependencies and resourcing with business goals.
* Strengthen project governance, reporting and business insights by maintaining accurate project data, dashboards, portfolio reviews, milestone visibility, risk tracking and executive decision inputs.
* Collaborate across multiple business units, global PMO teams and functions including Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Software, Cybersecurity, Service and Operations to drive alignment, remove dependencies and ensure successful project delivery.
* Manage and develop project leaders while enabling effective risk, resources, budget and compliance management, including QMS adherence, design control expectations, change governance and audit\-ready execution.


**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Life Sciences, Computer Science or a related technical discipline; PMP®, PMI\-ACP, Agile, Lean or equivalent certification is preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in Software project, program, portfolio management and multiple years of PMO leadership, preferably within medical devices, diagnostics, life sciences or another regulated product development environment.
* Proven ability to lead PMO governance, portfolio execution, milestone tracking, risk management, resource alignment, budget oversight and executive\-level reporting for complex cross\-functional programs.
* Experience working in global matrix organizations and collaborating across business units and functions such as Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Software, Cybersecurity, Service, Operations and Commercial teams.
* Working knowledge of Software product development lifecycle processes, QMS expectations, design control, change governance, audit readiness and compliance requirements in regulated environments.


**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**
* Experience with Agile, SAFe and Hybrid delivery models delivering software products /solutions.
