4afed501.title: Senior Architect
4afed501.description:
**About The Job**
 A Senior Architect is able to act as a solution lead for small to medium sized teams delivering standard to complex solutions as well as influence Client Architects, technical individual contributors, and up to Director level (or equivalent) managers. They are accountable for having established expertise of process, concept, and technical knowledge in pre\-sales and delivery. A Senior Architect is able to impact their region and has strong connections within teams outside of their career path.
   

  

 As a Senior Architect, you will lead the strategic design and implementation of OpenShift\-based platforms that bridge the gap between traditional DevOps and modern MLOps. Your mission is to architect resilient, scalable environments that allow data scientists to move from "laptop to production" without the friction of infrastructure silos. You will be the primary advisor for clients navigating the complexities of GPU orchestration, Model Serving, and Hybrid Cloud AI.
   

  

 Note: This role may come into contact with confidential or sensitive customer information requiring special treatment in accordance with Red Hat policies and applicable privacy laws.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
 OpenShift Platform Engineering
   

  

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design and automate the deployment of OpenShift clusters across hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, On\-prem).
* Cluster Management: Implement Multi\-Cluster Management using Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management (ACM) and ensure security compliance via Advanced Cluster Security (ACS).
* Scaling \& Optimization: Tune OpenShift for high\-performance AI workloads, including specialized GPU node labeling, partitioning, and autoscaling.


 OpenShift AI \& MLOps Orchestration
   

  

* AI Lifecycle Design: Architect the full AI lifecycle on OpenShift AI, integrating JupyterHub, Elyra pipelines, and internal model registries.
* Inference \& Serving: Design high\-concurrency model serving architectures using KServe, Caikit, and TGIS (Text Generation Inference Server) for LLMs.
* InstructLab Integration: Lead clients in using InstructLab on OpenShift to fine\-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) with proprietary enterprise data.


 Strategic Consulting
   

  

* Sovereign AI Strategy: Advise regulated industry clients (Banking, Healthcare, Gov) on how to maintain data sovereignty while leveraging Generative AI.
* TCO Analysis: Help clients understand the Total Cost of Ownership of running AI on OpenShift vs. proprietary SaaS AI platforms.
* Developer Experience (DevEx): Create a seamless workflow for developers and data scientists, reducing "time\-to\-first\-token."


**What Will You Bring**
* Consulting DNA: 15\+ years in professional services with a knack for whiteboarding complex YAML\-wrangling into a business\-friendly vision.
* Red Hat Mastery: Proven track record of deploying OpenShift in production\-grade, air\-gapped, or highly regulated environments.
* AI/ML Fluency: Solid understanding of the AI development lifecycle—you don't need to be a Data Scientist, but you must speak "Data Science" fluently (embeddings, vector DBs, fine\-tuning).
* Security Mindset: Expertise in RBAC, Network Policies, and "Shift Left" security within the OpenShift ecosystem.


**Certifications (The "Gold Standard") but not mandatory**
* Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA) – The ultimate validator.
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and Management.
* Cloud\-specific Architect certifications (AWS SAP, Azure Solutions Architect).


**About Red Hat**
 Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community\-powered approach to deliver high\-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40\+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in\-office, to office\-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at Red Hat**
 Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
 Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
   

  

 Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
   

  

 Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application\-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

f590854d.title: Service Delivery Lead - Data and Cloud Platforms
f590854d.description:
**The best ops leaders are also great engineers!** 




 If you've spent years building on cloud and data platforms and you've started noticing something \- that the real bottlenecks aren't technical, they're operational, this role is built for you.
 



 At Vivanti, our Senior Consultant – Service Delivery isn't a manager who used to be technical. It's an engineer who chose to stay technical while taking on something harder: owning the full picture of how a complex managed service actually runs.
 



 You'll spend roughly a third of your time with your hands on the platform \- reviewing architectures, debugging incidents, stress\-testing automation, calling out what the monitoring isn't catching. The rest of your time, you're the person who decides how the team works, how the client relationship is held together, and how the service gets better every sprint.
 



 Vivanti works with some of Australia's largest enterprises across Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, GCP and beyond. You'll run the managed services engine for clients like these: multiple engagements simultaneously, serious technical depth required, high stakes when things go wrong.
 



  





**Your Career, Accelerated** 




 Vivanti, Australia's leading technology data and analytics consulting firm, is growing their team in their Bengaluru Global Delivery Center.
 



 Vivanti was founded as a platform for talented technologists who want to make a real impact for their clients. Some of the world’s biggest businesses turn to us to help bring their data strategy, AI, cloud engineering and digital solutions to life. We’re the home base for talented technologists who want more and are looking to take their career to the next level by having more learning, more variety, more support and more chances to do meaningful work.
 



 Our consultants use emerging technologies and best practices to help clients become more data driven across a range of industries. Recent projects include building a customer data platform for a leading Airline, an IoT based real\-time driver safety dashboard for a global logistics firm, architecture advisory for Australia’s largest radio network, a full fledged enterprise cloud and data platform for the world’s leading medical aid manufacturing company, to name a few.
 



 We work with all the major technologies used in the market today and are partners with some of the largest names in the industry i.e. Databricks, Snowflake, Google, AWS, Azure and many more.
 



 If that sounds like the kind of place you’d thrive in, keep reading.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**In the platform (30–40% of your time):** 



* Reviewing cloud and data architectures to catch what the team missed
* Leading technical triage on P1 incidents \- you're in the bridge call and you know what questions to ask
* Hands\-on with automation, scripting, and platform operations; you're not above writing the runbook yourself
* FinOps reviews: cost anomaly analysis, licence audits, resource right\-sizing \- technical work with a commercial lens
* Stress\-testing transition readiness: you define the gates before anything goes into BAU



**Running the service (the other 60%):** 



* Owning SLA performance and the RAID log across multiple client engagements
* Leading sprint retrospectives and daily standups \- you know what good agile looks like from having worked in it
* Writing executive service review packs that are worth reading: crisp, opinionated, built on real data
* Managing the Run/Change/Project boundary \- protecting BAU capacity from scope creep is a weekly fight
* Mentoring and performance\-managing a team of engineers; you've been one, so you know what good looks like
* Navigating commercial structures: fixed retainers, capacity tokens, NTE caps \- you understand these aren't just finance concepts



**With clients:** 



* Building trusted relationships with CXO and VP\-level stakeholders \- earned through technical credibility, not just seniority
* De\-escalating tense situations with empathy and precision, not corporate deflection
* Running EBRs that generate confidence rather than just consuming an hour



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 You came up through the technical side \- cloud engineering, data engineering, platform/DevOps \- and at some point you started solving problems that weren't purely technical. You got good at it. Now you want a role that's explicitly built around that combination.
 



 Specifically:
 


* **8\+ years** 
 in cloud and data environments, with a meaningful portion in managed services or operational delivery
* Hands\-on depth in at least one major platform: Azure, AWS, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks \- you can read infrastructure and diagnose at the code/config level, not just the dashboard level
* Experience managing complex client relationships, including conversations that got difficult
* Practical working knowledge of ITIL (Incident, Problem, Change) and Agile \- not just as frameworks you've heard of, but as operating practices you've run
* Commercial exposure: SOW management, scope negotiation, capacity planning \- you've had these conversations and held your ground
* The kind of judgment that only comes from having been in a P1 at 2am and having to make calls with incomplete information



 You don't need to have had "Service Delivery Manager" in a previous title. If your background is senior data or cloud engineering and you've been doing the ops, governance, and client work alongside the builds \- we want to talk.
 



  





**What You’ll Get** 




 We know you're bringing the skills, the passion and the drive. What we bring is the platform to help you go further.
 



 At Vivanti, you're not just taking a job, you're investing in your growth.
 



 Here’s a taste:
 


* A platform for growth: Work across industries, clients and technologies that stretch your thinking and build your personal and professional skills.
* Access global businesses: Work with some of the world's biggest brands
* IP, frameworks and accelerators: We share what we know. Our playbooks and toolkits fast\-track your success on projects.
* Access to a broad ecosystem of technologies
* Senior consultants who have your back: You’ll always have a guide on your journey, not just be thrown into the deep end.
* Serious learning support: Paid certs, weekly training, guilds, hackathons, mentoring and more.
* Progress that’s transparent: Annual Progress Reviews based on 360° feedback, not vague vibes. Clear goals, solid feedback and real growth.
* Toastmasters and Pitch sessions to embrace your public speaking and leadership skills
* Hackathons to gear up for technologies on the horizon
* Comprehensive Health Insurance
* Kudos and rewards: We celebrate wins, reward impact and offer long\-term incentives.
* Real connection: From Friday socials to annual team building days \- we work hard and play harder.



  





**Why Explore a Career at Vivanti** 




 We are a consultant led organisation. We invest heavily in our consultants to ensure they have the technical skills and commercial acumen to be successful in their work. Our consultants have a passion for data and solving complex problems. They are curious, ambitious and experts in their fields. We have developed a first rate team so you will be supported and learn from the best.
 



 We invest heavily in professional development both technically, through training and guided certification pathways, and in consulting, through workshops in client engagement and communication. Growth in our organisation happens from growth in our people.
 



 Working on your own macbooks in our custom designed offices in the heart of Bengaluru, away from the big tech parks, we provide a peaceful and productive work environment close to shops, parks and metro stations.
 



 Vivanti consultants engage with the business to give expert advice, solve problems and deliver data, analytics, digital, AI, customer and cloud solutions, by drawing on years of experience across diverse projects, industries and technologies!
 



  





**The Vivanti Interview Process** 




 We like keeping it to the point and explore a candidate's competence through 4 stages of:
 


* A technical online screening test where we do a baseline assessment of your problem solving skills
* Introductory and Cultural Assessment to make sure we are all on the same page in terms of our growth and career prospects.
* Technical Assessment to understand your technical competency assessed by our technical panel.
* Final Round to make sure the technicality is in balance with the aptitude and culture fit.



 And after this, you pack and join us: )

553f9c16.title: Senior Managed Services Consultant
553f9c16.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Support managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers by configuring, optimizing, and maintaining platform solutions across digital and voice channels. Focus on execution, operational stability, customer support, and ongoing platform adoption.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Support configuration and maintenance of Sprinklr CCaaS solutions across chat, messaging, email, social, and voice channels.
* Execute platform updates aligned to defined solution blueprints, best practices, and core configuration architecture.
* Assist in configuring and maintaining routing logic, queues, IVR flows, case workflows, SLA rules, and escalations.
* Support bot workflows, automation rules, and bot\-to\-agent handoff configurations to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify basic platform gaps, configuration issues, and optimization opportunities, and recommend improvements aligned to customer requirements.
* Help maintain platform adoption by supporting users in understanding and using configured features effectively.
* Provide day\-to\-day support for post go\-live enhancements, troubleshooting, and configuration changes.
* Assist in monitoring customer operations metrics such as SLA adherence, queue performance, response times, and agent productivity.
* Support basic API, CRM, and third\-party integration activities, including validation and workflow coordination.
* Help onboard and train new agents, admins, and users on workflows, platform usage, and best practices.
* Work closely with Lead consultants and customer stakeholders to ensure configurations remain aligned to business needs and solution design.
* Support Customer Success and Sales teams by sharing platform adoption updates and operational insights where relevant.
* Document configurations, update process guides, and contribute to reusable knowledge and best practices.


**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of experience in CCaaS, managed services, technical support, or platform operations.
* Working knowledge of Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco, or other contact center technologies.
* Experience with queues, routing, workflows, dashboards, SLA setup, or case management.
* Foundational understanding of IVR, telephony concepts, chatbot workflows, and platform automation.
* Basic knowledge of API, CRM integration concepts, and cross\-system workflow dependencies.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and configuration support skills.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to digital and social engagement channels.
* Understanding of customer support operations and service KPIs.
* Experience supporting user training and onboarding.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.


**Who You Are**
* Detail\-oriented and hands\-on with a strong execution mindset.
* Comfortable working in customer\-facing, fast\-paced support environments.
* A collaborative team player with growing technical and consulting skills.
* Focused on quality, platform stability, and customer success.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Accurate and reliable platform configurations.
* Stable day\-to\-day CCaaS operations and timely issue resolution.
* Strong support for customer adoption and user onboarding.
* Consistent contribution to operational efficiency and customer outcomes.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

2540e306.title: 10. Senior Technical Program Manager
2540e306.description:
**About** **PayPay India**
--------------------------


PayPay, a fintech company providing a service enjoyed by 70 million users (as of July 2025\) merely 7 years since its launch in 2018 in Japan. The company is now home to a very diverse team of members from more than 50 countries. We grew to a team of several thousand employees in Japan but are far from over. We are still in the Day 1\. Every day, new members join us from all over the world to create new value and deliver it to society.  


**Why India ?**
---------------


To build our Payment services, we got technical cooperation from Paytm (A large payment service company in India). And based on their customer\-first technologies , we created and expanded the smartphone payment service in Japan. Therefore, we have decided to establish a development base in India, because it is a major IT country with many talented engineers, as evidenced by the fact that cutting\-edge mobile payments can continue to be generated.


**OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED**
---------------------------


We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realise a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined.
**AI\-First Culture at PayPay**
-------------------------------


At PayPay, we believe the future of software development is AI\-augmented engineering. Every engineer is expected to actively leverage AI tools for code reviews, testing, documentation, debugging, and productivity improvements. AI is not optional — it is a mandatory part of our daily engineering workflow. Candidates must demonstrate both hands\-on experience and the right mindset to integrate AI effectively into their workflow, while maintaining the engineering rigor, ownership, and problem\-solving skills that only humans can provide
**Job Description**
-------------------


This role is based in **PayPay India** and focuses on technical program management across PayPay's product and platform portfolio. You will drive programs spanning payment processing, regulatory compliance, and platform integrations. The role requires close collaboration with India\-based engineering teams and stakeholders across PayPay's headquarters in Japan.


### **MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**


### **Program Execution \& Delivery**


* Independently drive technical programs of varying complexity, from well\-defined projects to programs with multiple dependencies and cross\-functional impact.
* Establish and maintain program governance: risk registers, dependency maps, milestone tracking, and status reporting aligned to PayPay KPI framework (Predictability, Governance, Technical Health, Architecture).
* Monitor program health across progress, risks, blockers, and timelines. Communicate transparently with stakeholders and escalate proactively.
* Make program\-level decisions on scope, schedule, and trade\-offs with increasing autonomy.

### **Technical \& Product Engagement**


* Contribute to and influence technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and TDD (Technical Design Document) reviews with focus on security, compliance, and payment integrity.
* Engage with AI/ML applications in FinTech (fraud detection, risk scoring, recommendation engines) as they relate to program scope.
* Ensure completion of non\-functional requirements (Security, Performance, Compliance, Regulatory Requirements) prior to release milestones.
* Partner with Engineering Managers and Product Managers to translate business goals into actionable execution plans aligned with financial services standards.

### **Agile \& Process Leadership**


* Champion Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) within assigned teams, fostering transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Tailor PayPay SDLC practices to team context while maintaining alignment with organizational standards.
* Facilitate planning, retrospectives, and cross\-team coordination meetings as needed.
* Leverage generative AI tools appropriately to enhance productivity in documentation, analysis, and communication tasks.
* Identify and drive process improvements that benefit program delivery and team effectiveness.

### **Stakeholder Management \& Communication**


* Manage stakeholder alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, QA, and business partners.
* Build strong working relationships across teams and geographies (India, Japan headquarters).
* Represent programs in leadership forums and cross\-functional planning sessions.

### **Mentorship \& Collaboration**


* Mentor junior TPMs and new team members on program management fundamentals, PayPay processes, and best practices.
* Contribute to the TPM community knowledge base and process documentation.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment within programs and teams.

### **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
* 10\+ years professional experience, including 5–7 years in technical program management
* Experience in FinTech, payments, banking, or financial services with exposure to payment processing or regulated product development
* Strong understanding of software architecture, payment systems, and SDLC
* Proven experience managing complex technical programs with multiple dependencies and cross\-functional teams
* Understanding of security and compliance requirements in financial services
* Practical use of generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) for program management productivity
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* + Deep knowledge of security and compliance frameworks in financial services (e.g., data protection, transaction security, regulatory standards)
	+ Experience managing third\-party integrations (payment gateways, banking systems, settlement platforms)
	+ Experience managing AI/ML\-driven programs in FinTech (fraud detection, risk models, transaction monitoring) with ability to identify AI\-specific risks (data quality, model drift, bias, explainability)
	+ Technical depth: working knowledge of programming languages, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines
	+ Business\-level English fluency for global collaboration
	+ Experience mentoring TPMs or leading process improvement initiatives
	+ **Leverage AI/LLM\-based tools in daily workflows (e.g., code development, reviews, testing, debugging, documentation), while ensuring human oversight, judgment, and accountability drive the final product.**

### **Remarks**


＊Please note that you cannot apply for PayPay (Japan\-based jobs) or other positions in parallel or in duplicate.


### **PayPay 5 senses**


* Please refer PayPay 5 senses to learn what we value at work.

acc7d397.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Selection Monitoring
acc7d397.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (Sr. TPM) to join the Selection Monitoring team. In this role, you will drive and deliver complex, cross\-functional technical programs that are critical to the selection discovery and extraction components of Amazon's Selection Gap Closure and World Product Catalog (WPC) initiatives. You will operate at the intersection of multiple two\-pizza teams (2PTs) and collaborate closely with external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of large\-scale programs. The systems you will work across leverage Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) extensively for information extraction, content understanding, and intelligent automation — and a key outcome of your work will be reducing Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) dependencies to enable fully autonomous, scalable operations.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Program Leadership: Own and drive end\-to\-end delivery of complex technical projects spanning multiple 2PTs across SDO, ensuring alignment on goals, timelines, and dependencies
* Cross\-Team Coordination: Serve as the central coordination point across internal SDO teams and external stakeholders, managing interdependencies, resolving blockers, and driving alignment across organizational boundaries
* Technical Depth: Engage deeply with large\-scale information extraction, data processing, and orchestration systems — many of which are powered by GenAI/LLM\-based models — to understand technical constraints, identify risks, and drive informed trade\-off decisions
* HITL Reduction \& Automation: Drive programs that systematically reduce Human\-in\-the\-Loop interventions by leveraging GenAI/LLM capabilities, enabling the organization to scale operations without proportional headcount growth
* Selection Gap Closure – Discovery \& Extraction: Drive the selection discovery and extraction workstreams that feed into the broader Selection Gap Closure program, including source identification, web crawling, and product data extraction from off\-Amazon websites World Product Catalog (WPC) – Discovery
* Extraction: Own the SDO\-scoped delivery of WPC's selection discovery and extraction pipeline — ensuring product data is reliably discovered, crawled, and extracted at scale to feed downstream ASIN creation and catalog enrichment systems
* GenAI/LLM Program Delivery: Coordinate the development and deployment of LLM\-powered solutions across the selection discovery pipeline — including autonomous web navigation, intelligent content extraction, and automated data transformation
* Stakeholder Management: Communicate program status, risks, and milestones to senior leadership and cross\-functional partners; influence without authority to drive outcomes across teams
* Operational Excellence: Establish and maintain program mechanisms (e.g., status reviews, risk registers, dependency tracking) to ensure predictable delivery and early identification of issues
* Scaling \& Automation: Identify opportunities to improve program efficiency through better tooling, AI\-driven automation, and process optimization across data pipelines and orchestration workflows
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

72514d1c.description:
**About the role and team**  

  

Leading in a high\-growth environment means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will drive structure and coordination for large\-scale, complex engineering initiatives that power the bedrock of the platform\-from core service layers to data infrastructure that supports millions of real\-time transactions. This role is about navigating the reality of modernizing critical products and security frameworks while the business moves at high velocity.  

  

You will be a strategic operator and cross\-functional influencer, owning the end\-to\-end lifecycle of technical programs that span Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Legal. You will make data\-driven decisions on prioritization, manage complex dependencies, and impact global reliability and data privacy. We are looking for a professional who can solve architectural puzzles and elevate technical program management standards across a global organization.  

  

**What you'll do*** Lead complex technical programs from inception to delivery, resolving cross\-team dependencies and evaluating risks in real\-time.
* Partner with engineering leads to conceptualize architectural solutions and translate product visions into detailed execution roadmaps and resource plans.
* Drive execution velocity by identifying systemic bottlenecks, managing escalations, and removing obstacles to maintain project momentum.
* Champion engineering and operational excellence, implementing continuous improvements to program management processes.
* Navigate high\-stakes ambiguity by balancing priorities across diverse stakeholders, including leadership, technical teams, and legal/compliance partners.
* Use a data\-driven approach to define program KPIs, track progress, and provide actionable insights for decision\-making.

**Basic Qualifications*** 7\+ years of experience in technical program management or software development leadership.
* Experience shipping large\-scale programs while managing scheduling, resource planning, and stakeholder communication for senior\-level audiences.
* Technical aptitude with the ability to understand distributed systems and translate technical issues into prioritized actions.
* Experience predicting execution risks and building data\-backed proposals to achieve team alignment.
* Experience with the product development lifecycle, including creating technical documentation (such as PRDs or ERDs).
* Experience driving efficiencies through process definition, runbooks, or tooling automation.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).

**Preferred Qualifications*** Expertise in specialized domains such as Data Security, Privacy (GDPR, SOC 2\), Internal Audit, or Infrastructure cost optimization.
* Background in software engineering or engineering management, specifically within microservice or DevOps environments.
* Experience with data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Tableau) to drive analysis and automation.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, CISA, CISSP, or CIA.
* Ability to resolve ambiguity in fast\-paced environments and manage hands\-on technical challenges.

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  

  

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  

  

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

193e12d9.title: Senior Program Manager
193e12d9.description:
**Bring more to life.**


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next\-generation, life\-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


As the Senior Program Manager (PMO) at Leica Biosystems IDC, Bangalore, you will lead the IDC PMO function and drive disciplined execution across new Software product development, sustaining engineering, Software product lifecycle management, change requests and strategic site initiatives. You will strengthen portfolio governance, improve project data quality and transparency, and enable timely leadership decisions on priorities, resources, risks and trade\-offs. This role will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Software, Cybersecurity, Service, Operations and external partners to translate the IDC project roadmap into well\-governed, well\-executed programs.


This position reports to the Director of LBS IDC and will work closely with local and global stakeholders across the Leica Biosystems organization. The role is based on site at Leica Biosystems IDC, Bangalore.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Lead and mature the IDC PMO functions by establishing governance routines, standard work, execution cadence, templates, metrics and escalation paths that improve delivery discipline and accountability.
* Drive portfolio execution across NPD, sustaining engineering, lifecycle management, change requests and strategic site initiatives by aligning priorities, milestones, dependencies and resourcing with business goals.
* Strengthen project governance, reporting and business insights by maintaining accurate project data, dashboards, portfolio reviews, milestone visibility, risk tracking and executive decision inputs.
* Collaborate across multiple business units, global PMO teams and functions including Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Software, Cybersecurity, Service and Operations to drive alignment, remove dependencies and ensure successful project delivery.
* Manage and develop project leaders while enabling effective risk, resources, budget and compliance management, including QMS adherence, design control expectations, change governance and audit\-ready execution.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Life Sciences, Computer Science or a related technical discipline; PMP®, PMI\-ACP, Agile, Lean or equivalent certification is preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in Software project, program, portfolio management and multiple years of PMO leadership, preferably within medical devices, diagnostics, life sciences or another regulated product development environment.
* Proven ability to lead PMO governance, portfolio execution, milestone tracking, risk management, resource alignment, budget oversight and executive\-level reporting for complex cross\-functional programs.
* Experience working in global matrix organizations and collaborating across business units and functions such as Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Software, Cybersecurity, Service, Operations and Commercial teams.
* Working knowledge of Software product development lifecycle processes, QMS expectations, design control, change governance, audit readiness and compliance requirements in regulated environments.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Experience with Agile, SAFe and Hybrid delivery models delivering software products /solutions.
* Knowledge of DBS, Lean and continuous improvement practices is desirable.


Leica Biosystems, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

e2a86a66.title: Program Manager, Manufacturing & Supply AI Transformation
e2a86a66.description:
**Job title** : Program Manager, Manufacturing \& Supply AI Transformation


* ***Location: Hyderabad***

Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.


At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.


As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.


About the job:


We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to drive the execution of Opella’s Manufacturing \& Supply Data and AI Transformation. This role focuses on translating strategy into action — coordinating cross\-regional initiatives, accelerating delivery, and embedding AI\-enabled capabilities across the global Manufacturing \& Supply network.


The ideal candidate is a strong operator who brings a passion for AI and technology advancement, thrives in complex environments, and excels at orchestrating large\-scale transformation programs with speed and focus. Operating at the heart of the MS.AI Factory, you will convert strategy and a live use\-case pipeline into adopted, value\-generating solutions across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality.


**Main Responsibilities**

* **Program Execution \& Delivery**
* **Lead the end\-to\-end execution** of Data \& AI initiatives across Manufacturing \& Supply — from use\-case intake and feasibility assessment through delivery, deployment, and adoption.
* **Manage the project portfolio,** ensuring alignment with transformation priorities and milestone achievement.
* **Drive a high speed of execution** through active issue resolution, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
* **Operational Leadership**
* **Translate strategic direction** into clear implementation plans and structured execution frameworks.
* **Partner across functions —** Manufacturing, Supply, IT, Data Science, Quality, and Finance — to ensure operational readiness and cohesion.
* **Maintain disciplined governance** across risk management, reporting, and resource planning.
* **Challenger Mindset \& Innovation**
* **Challenge existing processes** constructively and introduce innovative, data\-driven ways of working.
* **Advocate for modern digital solutions** and emerging technologies — including AI, agents, and automation — to drive meaningful improvement.
* **Foster a culture** of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
* **Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management**
* **Engage stakeholders** across Europe and India to ensure alignment, collaboration, and adoption.
* **Lead change efforts** to embed AI, automation, and analytics into operational processes — including Copilot enablement and the AI Champions network.
* **Provide clear communication** to leadership on progress, risks, and realized benefits.

About you:


Required Skills \& Qualifications


* **Software \& AI Engineering:** Strong hands\-on development skills (Python), with production\-ready software engineering practices — OOP, coding standards, version control, testing, and CI/CD.
* **Agentic AI \& GenAI:** Experience designing and deploying LLM\-powered and agentic solutions (RAG, autonomous and multi\-agent systems), with MCP\-based integrations, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
* **System Integration:** Proven ability to integrate solutions directly into enterprise systems via APIs; exposure to MES / QMS / ERP (SAP) and manufacturing / supply chain data.
* **MLOps / AgentOps:** Experience operationalizing models and agents — automated build / test / deploy, monitoring, and observability (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow or similar; GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
* **Cloud \& Data:** Comfortable in cloud and high\-performance environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake) and building data pipelines.
* **Business Understanding:** Familiarity with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality processes and KPIs, and the ability to translate business problems into deployable agents.
* **Experience:** \[Add required years] of hands\-on experience building and deploying production AI / software solutions; life\-sciences or regulated (GxP) manufacturing experience is a strong plus.
* **Education:** Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

**Education**

* **Bachelor’s degree required;** advanced degree (MBA, Engineering, Data/AI) preferred.

**Experience**

* **8\+ years** of experience managing large\-scale transformation or digital programs.
* **Strong exposure to Manufacturing \& Supply** environments, preferably global or regulated.
* **Demonstrated experience** deploying data, analytics, automation, or AI capabilities at scale.

**Leadership Requirements**

* **Passion for AI \& Technology Advancement:** demonstrated enthusiasm for new digital technologies and their application in operational environments.
* **Speed \& Agility:** proven ability to simplify, prioritize, and deliver rapidly.
* **Challenger Mindset:** constructively challenges historical norms and introduces innovative alternatives.
* **Influence \& Collaboration:** effective working across diverse teams, functions, and geographies.
* **Execution Excellence:** strong structure, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* **Comfort with Ambiguity:** navigates shifting priorities and complex environments confidently.

**Technical Requirements**

* **AI/ML Lifecycle:** understanding of model development, deployment, and monitoring.
* **Frameworks \& Tools:** familiarity with machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and data engineering tools (SQL, Python, Spark).
* **Cloud \& Governance:** experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise data governance.
* **Business Translation:** ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and operational outcomes.

**Soft \& Behavioral Skills**

* **Challenger Mindset:** proactively questions the status quo and drives innovation and pace across the transformation portfolio.
* **All In, Together:** builds strong, collaborative relationships across global, cross\-functional, and partner teams.
* **Outcome\-Obsessed:** relentlessly focused on delivering measurable business impact and realized benefits, not just activity.
* **Courageous:** takes ownership, makes decisions in ambiguity, and drives initiatives through to completion.
* **Radically Simple:** brings clarity and simplicity to complex programs, stakeholders, and reporting.

Why This Role Matters


* This role is critical to accelerating Opella’s digital capability across Manufacturing \& Supply. The Program Manager will ensure strategic direction is executed effectively, driving measurable improvements across Europe, India, and the broader global network.

Why us?


At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.


**We Are Challengers.**

We are dedicated to making self\-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:


**All In Together:** We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.


**Courageous:** We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.


**Outcome\-Obsessed:** We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.


**Radically Simple:** We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.


Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

360c05a4.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience leading technical discussions and plans.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Strong technical judgment and experience guiding technical decisions and discussions.
* Demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex, cross\-functional technical programs end\-to\-end.
* Excellent ability to influence without authority and drive consensus across engineering, product, and UX.
* Exceptional communication skills, articulating complex topics to technical and non\-technical audiences.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 In this critical portfolio level role, you will take lead on execution and delivery governance across multiple workstreams. This portfolio is in the process of building cross\-functional operating model maturity, with a focus on effective and efficient delivery at scale. You will have the opportunity to drive process improvements across cross\-functional teams and work with stakeholders across different business units on their top compliance priorities, on some of the top priorities. To be successful in the role in addition to program management skills, you will need to have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and gain buy\-in across various stakeholder groups of technical and non\-technical teams across Google. You will be involved in all phases of the projects, including requirements gathering, planning, design, and deployment, through full integration.
   

  

 You will be part of a Global Payments Platform team and community working at global scale, with the opportunity to collaborate and drive impact not just within your program but also across the Payments community.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to understand or identify defined work problems and program goals, obtain prioritized deliverables, and discuss program impact.
* Prioritize program goals, understand and translate other stakeholders needs into program goals and prioritized deliverables with minimal assistance, and contribute to decisions on prioritizing goals and deliverables.
* Define the scope of projects and develop, execute, or manage project plans for supported programs.
* Review key metrics pertaining to a program, monitor potential metric deviations, and define corrective actions for critical deviations.

8d2f9d09.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Business Systems
8d2f9d09.description:
**Overview**
 Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete AI Revenue Workflow Platform that helps sales leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. Outreach infuses agentic AI to power 100s of use cases across sales motions. From new logo prospecting to renewal and expansion, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Global organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including SAP, Siemens, Snowflake, ZoomInfo, and Verizon to name a few. To learn more, please visit www.outreach.io.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At Outreach, Business Systems’ mission is to enable and enhance corporate processes at scale. We are a centralized team providing a suite of services to other Outreachers, helping them to efficiently serve our customers and each other. We are building the team around strong critical thinkers \- individuals who can navigate ambiguity and help us along our journey of discovery and transformation.
   

  

**The Role**
 Outreach is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Business Systems team as a TPM aligned closely to our Finance systems portfolio. This role owns the strategy and execution across our end\-to\-end Finance technology stack, spanning ERP, procurement, expense management, and HR financial workflows.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise systems experience, strong cross\-functional instincts, and the technical fluency to navigate integrations across a modern Finance tech stack.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Finance, Engineering, and Operations leadership to drive delivery, shape system strategy, and build durable program practices for a high\-visibility portfolio.
   

  

**Your Daily Adventures Will Include**
* Own the TPM strategy for Outreach's Finance systems portfolio, serving as the primary program lead across ERP, procurement, expense, and financial operations tooling
* Lead end\-to\-end program management for large\-scale Finance system initiatives, including milestones, risk mitigation, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication across Finance, Engineering, and Operations
* Develop and execute project plans that span multiple teams and systems; proactively identify and resolve blockers across the full delivery lifecycle
* Navigate shifting requirements and evolving business needs by refining scope, clarifying intent, and realigning delivery expectations with stakeholders
* Drive UAT coordination with business stakeholders, ensuring readiness across Finance workflows before production deployment
* Build and maintain program\-level communication rhythms, tailored for both executive sponsors and cross\-functional leads
* Manage cross\-functional delivery challenges with limited precedent; drive convergence in complex decision spaces involving Finance, IT, and external vendors
* Establish and scale QA checkpoints, integration planning practices, and change management processes within the Finance systems portfolio
* Advise on tooling decisions, integration strategy, and platform trade\-offs across the Finance systems landscape
* Informally guide TPM best practices across the team; contribute to cross\-team execution frameworks and delivery culture


**Our Vision Of You**
* 5\+ years of technical program management experience, with at least 2 years on enterprise finance systems or ERP platforms
* Demonstrated experience leading ERP migrations or large\-scale system transitions (NetSuite, SAP, or equivalent)
* Ability to manage shifting requirements across multi\-stakeholder environments; experience aligning Finance, Engineering, and Operations teams around shared delivery goals
* Strong understanding of enterprise system architecture, data flows, and integrations — able to translate business requirements into technical inputs and flag risks proactively
* Experience coordinating UAT with business stakeholders and driving accountability across cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with Finance\-adjacent tools such as Concur, Workday, ZipHQ, or similar platforms is a strong plus
* Proficient in defect/issue tracking tools such as Jira; comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to clearly communicate program status, risks, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences, up to executive level
* Self\-starter who identifies quality and delivery risks proactively, without waiting to be asked
* Experience in a SaaS or high\-growth technology environment preferred


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
* Generous medical, dental, and vision coverage for full\-time employees and their dependents
* Flexible time off
* 401k to help you save for the future
* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN\+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA\+), Gender\+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
* A parental leave program that includes not just extended time off but options for a paid night nurse, and a gradual return to work
* Infertility/ assisted reproductive services benefit
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Plus, unlimited snacks and beverages in our kitchen
* We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status


***Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants\-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.***

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. 11806864.description:
**Description**
 We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (Sr. TPM) to join the Selection Monitoring team. In this role, you will drive and deliver complex, cross\-functional technical programs that are critical to the selection discovery and extraction components of Amazon's Selection Gap Closure and World Product Catalog (WPC) initiatives. You will operate at the intersection of multiple two\-pizza teams (2PTs) and collaborate closely with external stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of large\-scale programs. The systems you will work across leverage Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) extensively for information extraction, content understanding, and intelligent automation — and a key outcome of your work will be reducing Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) dependencies to enable fully autonomous, scalable operations.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Program Leadership: Own and drive end\-to\-end delivery of complex technical projects spanning multiple 2PTs across SDO, ensuring alignment on goals, timelines, and dependencies
* Cross\-Team Coordination: Serve as the central coordination point across internal SDO teams and external stakeholders, managing interdependencies, resolving blockers, and driving alignment across organizational boundaries
* Technical Depth: Engage deeply with large\-scale information extraction, data processing, and orchestration systems — many of which are powered by GenAI/LLM\-based models — to understand technical constraints, identify risks, and drive informed trade\-off decisions
* HITL Reduction \& Automation: Drive programs that systematically reduce Human\-in\-the\-Loop interventions by leveraging GenAI/LLM capabilities, enabling the organization to scale operations without proportional headcount growth
* Selection Gap Closure – Discovery \& Extraction: Drive the selection discovery and extraction workstreams that feed into the broader Selection Gap Closure program, including source identification, web crawling, and product data extraction from off\-Amazon websites World Product Catalog (WPC) – Discovery
* Extraction: Own the SDO\-scoped delivery of WPC's selection discovery and extraction pipeline — ensuring product data is reliably discovered, crawled, and extracted at scale to feed downstream ASIN creation and catalog enrichment systems
* GenAI/LLM Program Delivery: Coordinate the development and deployment of LLM\-powered solutions across the selection discovery pipeline — including autonomous web navigation, intelligent content extraction, and automated data transformation
* Stakeholder Management: Communicate program status, risks, and milestones to senior leadership and cross\-functional partners; influence without authority to drive outcomes across teams
* Operational Excellence: Establish and maintain program mechanisms (e.g., status reviews, risk registers, dependency tracking) to ensure predictable delivery and early identification of issues
* Scaling \& Automation: Identify opportunities to improve program efficiency through better tooling, AI\-driven automation, and process optimization across data pipelines and orchestration workflows


**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

**About Us**
 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Your Role In a Nutshell**
 No two days are the same. You’ll work hands\-on with market\-leading technologies, diagnose customers’ toughest security challenges, and design solutions alongside partners—playing a central role in high\-impact projects from discovery through delivery.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Drive sales wins by partnering with partner sales teams: identify prospects, progress opportunities, and demonstrate Check Point’s value proposition.
* Present Check Point at partner\-led customer events, workshops, and industry forums.

The Solution Architect will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer\-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof\-of\-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
   

  

***This is a hands\-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
 The Solution Architect has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever\-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
   

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands\-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side

* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking \- quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories \& case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake


**REQUIREMENTS:**
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands\-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers

* Experience with large\-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Presales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem


**ADDED BONUS FOR:**
* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms

* Prior Snowflake experience is a plus
* Cloud Provider Experience \- Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud

* Lead design, integration, deployment, and testing of Packet Core elements (EPC \& 5GC) for enterprise solutions.

* Produce high\-level and low\-level designs, test plans, and configuration artifacts.

* Ensure alignment with 4G/5G standards and best practices across customer environments.

**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must Have:
   

  

* 12\+ years in telecom network delivery (4G/5G) experience.
* Knowledge of 4G and 5G call flows, and overall knowledge of the latest technologies in the Telecom space including EPC, 5GC, VoLTE, IoT etc.
* Knowledge of 3GPP specs (e.g., 23\.401, 23\.501, 23\.502\).
* Experience in deployment of EPC \& 5GC network functions on OpenStack and containerized cloud environments.
* Knowledge of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, routes, eBGP, OSPF and IP subnetting, switching stack.

 Nice to have:
   

  

* Knowledge on Radio, Routers, NMS from overall network perspective.
* Experience in IMS/VoLTE, RAN, HSS and UDM is an added advantage.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

92a739b3.title: Executive Manager | Delivery Manager | Hyderabad | Engineering as a Service/ Operate
92a739b3.description:
**Job Description/Key Responsibilities**

The Application Managed Services (AMS) Lead is a leadership role responsible for overseeing the delivery and strategic management of key Managed Services and Build Operate Transfer (BOT) engagements. This role acts as the responsible person for high\-quality execution across AMS and BOT engagements. Working closely with account managers, delivery teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders, this role drives operational excellence, client satisfaction, and account growth. The position demands deep technical and domain expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to align delivery capabilities with evolving client needs and business goals. The role will report to the ADMS leader.

 **1\. Portfolio Leadership \& Delivery Oversight**

* Serve as the Delivery lead for assigned AMS and BOT accounts / engagements under the Applications portfolio.
* Ensure timely, high\-quality delivery across diverse projects – development, support, and application management.
* Govern delivery across technologies across custom apps, packaged apps, cloud\-native, mobile, and web\-based platforms as applicable
* Drive Automation adaption across projects, drive delivery to ensure minimal client escalations and disruptions
* Be measured on delivery excellence KPIs

 **2\. Client Relationship Management**

* Partner with clients to develop strategic delivery plans aligned with digital transformation and modernization goals.
* Ensure a high level of client satisfaction, project transparency, and proactive communication.

 **3\. Delivery Leadership**

* Supervise team members delivering projects for each engagement as assigned.
* Ensure effective prioritization, governance, delivery health checks, and management of escalations.
* Oversee application lifecycle services – from design, build, and deploy to operate and support phases.

 **4\. Resource Planning \& Capability Management**

* Collaborate with resource management and project leads to ensure optimal allocation and utilization of squads including developers, testers, scrum masters, DevOps engineers, and integration experts.
* Build capabilities within the team by mentoring and upskilling based on technology and market needs.

 **6\. Governance Reporting \& Compliance**

* Define governance mechanisms including review cadence, KPI tracking, performance dashboards, and issue/risk logs.

**7\. Collaboration with Other Functions**

* Work closely with the Transition Managers, Change Management, and Transformation teams to ensure seamless onboarding, service stability, and continuous improvement.
* Integrate input from DevOps, Integration Engineers, Business Analysts, and Functional Consultants into delivery practices.

**Experience**

* **10\+ Years of experience** in IT application delivery with at least 5\+ years in a senior leadership role managing application portfolios.
* Hands\-on experience in delivering large\-scale application services across multiple technology stacks (custom, packaged, SaaS).
* Proven ability to manage and scale teams across geographies in an onshore\-offshore/hybrid model.

**Educational Background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or IT (required).
* Postgraduate degree in Management or Technology (MBA/M.Tech) is preferred.
* Certifications such as PMP, ITIL, Agile/SAFe, or cloud\-related credentials are a plus.

**Skills Required**

**Application \& Domain Expertise:**

* Deep understanding of application development and support processes across SDLC and DevOps pipelines.
* Familiarity with packaged applications (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft), custom development frameworks (.NET, Java, Python), and modern cloud\-native stacks (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Strategic Delivery Leadership:**

* Strong experience in managing delivery for transformation, integration, modernization, and AMS engagements.

 **Client Relationship \& Account Management:**

* Ability to influence and communicate with C\-level stakeholders across business and technology.
* Experience in navigating large, complex clients with evolving priorities and managing relationships over the long term.

 **People Management \& Organizational Growth:**

* Excellent leadership skills – team motivation, performance management, career development.
* Capacity planning, workforce forecasting, and people engagement.

 **Process, Quality \& Governance:**

* Proficient in delivery governance, SLA/KPI monitoring, and continuous improvement frameworks.
* Exposure to Agile, DevOps, ITIL, and application operations frameworks.

 **Technology \& Tools:**

* Experience working with platforms and tools such as JIRA, Git, Jenkins, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, and monitoring/logging tools.
* Familiarity with automation, testing frameworks, and performance tools.

e7c68c6f.title: Project Manager - IT Solutions
e7c68c6f.description:
𝗣𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Project Manager
