 𝗘𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗧𝘆𝗽𝗲: Full\-time
 



 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲: 10\+ Years 
 



  





 𝗡𝗼𝘁𝗲: Indore\-based candidates will be preferred.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Hiteshi Infotech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise software development projects. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in IT services and hands\-on experience managing web, mobile application, and custom software development projects.
 



 This role requires a proactive leader who can manage multiple projects simultaneously, mentor Technical Leads and cross\-functional teams, build strong client relationships, and ensure successful project delivery while maintaining the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, governance, and successful delivery of multiple software development projects.
* Manage web, mobile application, custom software, and enterprise application development projects simultaneously.
* Collaborate with Sales and Solution Teams during estimation, effort analysis, proposal reviews, and project planning activities.
* Validate project scope, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery feasibility before project kickoff.
* Participate in post\-sales discussions and client handover meetings to understand project scope, clarify requirements, provide delivery inputs, and ensure a seamless transition from Sales to Project Execution.
* Understand client requirements and translate them into well\-defined project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
* Lead, mentor, and guide Technical Leads and cross\-functional development teams to achieve high performance.
* Own client relationships by conducting regular meetings, providing project updates, managing expectations, gathering feedback, and ensuring high customer satisfaction (CSAT).
* Plan and manage project timelines, resource allocation, budgets, scope, risks, dependencies, and escalations.
* Drive delivery excellence by implementing Agile, Scrum, and SDLC best practices while promoting continuous process improvement.
* Define and maintain project governance frameworks including sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, steering committee meetings, and delivery governance
* Manage change requests, scope creep, impact analysis, approvals, and communication with clients.
* Monitor project health, track milestones, budgets, quality metrics, and overall delivery performance.
* Identify project risks proactively and implement mitigation plans to ensure timely delivery.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, MIS reports, meeting minutes, status reports, and governance records.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to improve delivery processes, team efficiency, and operational excellence.
* Monitor project financial performance, utilization, profitability, and ensure effective resource utilization.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 



* 10\+ years of experience in Project Management or Delivery Management within an IT Services company.
* Proven experience managing enterprise software development projects involving web, mobile applications, and custom software solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong leadership experience managing Technical Leads, Project Teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent client\-facing communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, SDLC, project governance, delivery management, and risk management.
* Experience in project planning, resource management, budgeting, scheduling, and delivery tracking.
* Hands\-on experience with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Trello, or similar platforms.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong focus on delivery excellence, business outcomes, and customer satisfaction.



  





**Preferred Qualification** 



* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, Agile, or equivalent project management certification is an added advantage.
* Experience managing large cross\-functional teams and enterprise\-scale software projects.
* Experience working with international clients and globally distributed teams.
* Exposure to AI\-driven solutions, cloud technologies, or digital transformation projects will be an added advantage.
* Experience in IT consulting or client\-facing service delivery environments is preferred.



  





 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗲'𝗿𝗲 𝗟𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗙𝗼𝗿
 



 We're looking for a confident leader who takes complete ownership of project delivery, builds high\-performing teams, and maintains strong client relationships. The ideal candidate should be able to balance business priorities, technical execution, and customer expectations while consistently delivering successful outcomes in a dynamic IT services environment

a7ccb1bc.title: Senior Program Manager-Beta Programs
a7ccb1bc.description:
Job Description
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.


If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!


Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Product Program Manager** to be part of making this/that happen.


**Position Overview and Objective**

The Beta Manager is responsible for defining, operating, and continuously improving Arctic Wolf's customer\-facing Beta Program. This role serves as the central coordinator for all beta initiatives, ensuring that new products, capabilities, integrations, and enhancements are validated by customers prior to General Availability.


The Beta Manager partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Product Marketing, Legal, Security, and IT teams to ensure beta programs deliver meaningful customer insights, measurable product improvements, and successful market launches.


This role owns beta program governance, participant recruitment, feedback collection, issue escalation, success measurement, reporting, and executive communications. The Beta Manager ensures every beta delivers actionable product validation while creating a positive customer experience and strengthening customer advocacy.


Own the company's Voice of Customer (VoC) strategy for pre\-GA products, ensuring customer insights directly influence product strategy, priorities, and release decisions.


Serve as the executive authority for release readiness recommendations, including Go, No\-Go, or Conditional Go recommendations for General Availability milestones.


**Responsibilities**

Product Validation Leadership


Establish measurable product validation frameworks to quantify product\-market fit, customer value realization, and adoption readiness before General Availability.


Partner with Product Management to ensure beta findings directly influence roadmap prioritization, backlog refinement, and investment decisions.


Customer Advisory Relationships


Build and manage a strategic network of beta champions, design partners, customer advisory board members, and executive customer sponsors.


Create closed\-loop feedback processes that ensure customers understand how their feedback influenced product decisions.


Beta Program Strategy \& Governance


* Define and maintain company\-wide Beta Program policies, standards, processes, and operational procedures.
* Establish consistent criteria for beta qualification, acceptance, execution, success measurement, and graduation to General Availability.
* Maintain governance processes for intake, prioritization, approvals, and executive visibility.
* Manage the Beta Command Center and associated operational cadences.

Beta Planning \& Execution


* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to define beta objectives, scope, timelines, success criteria, and exit requirements.
* Develop beta execution plans, including onboarding, communications, support, training, and reporting activities.
* Ensure beta readiness across product, support, documentation, legal, operational, and customer\-facing teams.
* Manage multiple concurrent beta programs across the product portfolio.

Customer Recruitment \& Engagement


* Partner with Customer Success, Sales, and Product Management to identify and recruit qualified beta participants.
* Maintain participant profiles, segmentation, and engagement history.
* Lead customer onboarding and enablement activities.
* Establish trusted relationships with beta participants and executive customer sponsors.

Customer Feedback Management


* Collect, consolidate, and analyze quantitative and qualitative customer feedback.
* Facilitate feedback review sessions with Product Management and Engineering.
* Ensure customer requests, issues, and enhancement opportunities are documented and tracked.
* Develop actionable recommendations based on participant feedback.

Risk, Dependency \& Issue Management


* Identify and manage program risks, blockers, customer concerns, and operational dependencies.
* Escalate critical issues to Product, Engineering, and executive stakeholders as appropriate.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and engagement throughout beta participation.
* Drive issue resolution and mitigation planning.

Reporting \& Analytics


* Develop beta performance dashboards and executive reporting.
* Track enrollment, activation, engagement, adoption, satisfaction, defect trends, and feature utilization.
* Measure beta effectiveness and business impact.
* Provide regular status updates to leadership and executive sponsors.

Advocacy \& Reference Development


* Partner with Product Marketing and Customer Marketing to identify advocacy opportunities.
* Support customer reference programs, testimonials, case studies, and speaking opportunities.
* Transition successful beta participants into customer advocacy programs.

Continuous Improvement


* Analyze beta outcomes and implement process improvements.
* Define best practices and reusable frameworks for future beta initiatives.
* Promote a customer\-centric culture focused on product validation and adoption.
* Drive operational excellence throughout the beta lifecycle.

**Experience \& Requirements**

* 8\+ years of experience in Program Management, Product Operations, Customer Success, Product Management, or related disciplines.
* 5\+ years of experience managing customer\-facing software deployments, pilots, beta programs, or release programs.
* Experience working within SaaS or cybersecurity environments.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development methodologies.
* Experience collaborating with Product Management and Engineering organizations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Experience managing at least ten enterprise\-scale beta or early access programs with measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience presenting beta program outcomes and release recommendations to executive leadership teams.

**Key Competencies**

* ### **Customer\-Centric Innovation \- Ability to uncover unmet customer needs and translate customer insights into actionable product improvements.**
* ### **Executive Influence \- Ability to confidently challenge launch assumptions and influence executive release decisions using objective customer and operational data.**
* ### **Customer Obsession \- Ability to advocate for customer outcomes and ensure customer feedback influences product decisions.**
* ### **Program Leadership \- Ability to coordinate complex cross\-functional programs and drive execution.**
* ### **Strategic Thinking \- Ability to align beta programs with organizational objectives and product strategy.**
* ### **Data\-Driven Decision Making \- Ability to leverage metrics, analytics, and customer feedback to guide decisions.**
* ### **Collaboration \& Influence \- Ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Support, and Executive teams.**
* ### **Communication Excellence \- Ability to communicate effectively with customers, executives, and technical stakeholders.**
* ### **Risk Management \- Proactively identify and address program, customer, and operational risks.**
* ### **Continuous Improvement \- Focus on process optimization, operational excellence, and scalability.**

**On\-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.


**About Arctic Wolf**

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.


**Our Values**

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.


We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.


We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.


All **India** wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:


* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* Fertility support and paid parental leave
* Employee Assistance Program

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.


**Security Requirements**

* Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
* Background checks are required for this position.
* This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

fa402e73.title: Engagement Manager
fa402e73.description:
*Associate / Engagement Manager — Fractional CFO \& Finance Advisory* 




**ABOUT SMARTFIN CONSULTING** 





 SmartFin Consulting is a fractional CFO and finance advisory firm that partners with founders and leadership teams to bring structure, clarity, and financial discipline to growing businesses. We work closely with startups and mid\-sized companies across IT/ITeS, FMCG, e\-commerce, services, healthcare, and technology; supporting them through scaling, investor readiness, strategic decision\-making, and finance transformation.
 





 Collaboration, ownership, and execution excellence sit at the core of how we work. We're looking for professionals who enjoy solving business problems, working directly with founders and leadership teams, and driving meaningful outcomes across multiple client engagements.
 




**THE ROLE** 





 We're hiring an Engagement Manager with 3–5 years of experience in finance, consulting, transaction advisory, business finance, or CFO advisory. This role suits a qualified CA or CFA who can independently manage client engagements, lead financial analysis, provide strategic insight, and act as a trusted advisor to founders and business leaders.
 





 You'll work directly with SmartFin leadership and client stakeholders, helping businesses improve financial performance, strengthen controls, enhance governance, and build scalable finance functions.
 





 You'll lead multiple client engagements across industries, owning financial reporting, business analysis, budgeting, cash flow management, strategic projects, compliance oversight, and stakeholder management, balancing strong technical finance capability with business acumen, project management, and senior\-stakeholder communication.
 




**CORE SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES WE'RE ASSESSING FOR** 





 Across the hiring process, we look for strength across six attributes:
 




**Attribute** 




**What Good Looks Like** 




**Core Finance \& Accounting Capability** 





 Qualified CA and/or CFA (Level II/III), with 3–5 years in finance, accounting, FP\&A, transaction advisory, or CFO advisory.
 





 Strong command of financial reporting, MIS, and Indian regulatory frameworks (GST, TDS, Companies Act, FEMA, RBI).
 




**Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills** 





 Advanced Excel and financial modelling ability; builds structure from raw, messy data.
 





 Moves fluidly from variance analysis to insight to a clear, actionable recommendation.
 




**Advisory \& Client\-Facing Skills** 





 Comfortable as a trusted advisor to founders, CEOs, and leadership, not just a report\-preparer.
 





 Communicates complex financial ideas simply and holds a point of view under pushback.
 




**Fractional Model Fit** 





 Manages multiple client engagements in parallel without dropping quality or context.
 





 Adapts quickly across industries, systems, and stakeholder styles; self\-directed with light oversight.
 




**SmartFin Culture \& Values Fit** 





 Ownership mindset — accountable for outcomes, not just tasks completed.
 





 Collaborative and coachable; comfortable mentoring juniors while still building their own craft.
 




**Practical Execution (Role\-Level Dependent)** 





 Engagement Manager: leads engagements independently, owns client relationships, reviews and mentors Analysts/Associates.
 





 Associate: delivers under guidance — models, MIS, and analysis — building toward independent client ownership.
 




**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. CFO Advisory \& Business Partnering** 





 Act as the primary day\-to\-day finance advisor for assigned clients.
 





 Work closely with founders, CEOs, and business leaders on strategic decision\-making.
 





 Identify opportunities to improve profitability, working capital, and cash flow.
 





 Drive finance transformation and process improvement initiatives.
 




**2\. Financial Reporting \& MIS** 





 Review and present monthly MIS, management reports, and performance analysis.
 





 Monitor key business metrics, profitability, cash flows, and operational KPIs.
 





 Analyze business trends and translate them into actionable recommendations.
 





 Present insights and performance updates to client leadership teams.
 




**3\. Budgeting, Forecasting \& FP\&A** 





 Lead annual budgeting and forecasting exercises.
 





 Develop financial models and scenario analyses.
 





 Track performance against budget and identify key variances.
 





 Support business planning and strategic growth initiatives.

 Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. By removing the IT burdens of managing storage infrastructures, customers can better align storage costs to business needs, accelerate time to value, and focus on core business operations by managing outcomes.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager in the Keystone PMO, you will play a pivotal role in driving complex, cross\-functional initiatives that deliver new features to the market for NetApp's STaaS offering. * Build deep and productive working relationships across Engineering, product management and business operations, understanding the Keystone product, challenging business assumptions and offering a point of view to assist in the decision\-making process.
* Identify important issues and risks, recommend options and facilitate team decisions.
* Anticipate roadblocks, resolve conflicts, and foster a culture of continuous improvement
* Lead regular program reviews with VPs and senior leaders.
* Drive product launch announcements and Enablement collateral with GTM, Marketing and Product teams
* Effective use of available AI technologies(Cursor, Copilot) to bring process efficiencies.


**Key Skills**
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast\-paced environment
* Results oriented: proven track record to take initiative, work with minimal direction, to deliver results.
* Expertise in JIRA, ADO, Microsoft technologies such as Power Automate, SharePoint etc.
* 8\+ years of experience in engineering/ technical project management / release management, with a proven track record of delivering complex projects.
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
* Good understanding of release management methodologies and best practices.
* Ability to understand project and resource interdependencies within a program or portfolio.

 Education
   

  

* A minimum of 8 years of experience is required.
* A Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or a Master’s Degree; or equivalent experience is required.

 At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
   

  

 NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. **Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in IT discipline preferred or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.


**Your** 
**Skill** 
**s**

* Ability to translate business requirements into functional solution designs and support delivery of scalable and supportable application enhancements.
* Experience supporting application lifecycle activities including incident management, testing, defect resolution, root cause analysis, and deployment activities.
* Experience troubleshooting and resolving application, data, and integration issues across SAP and connected enterprise systems.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across quality, manufacturing, and IT teams.
* Strong communication and documentation skills, including development of functional specifications, testing strategies, and support procedures.
* Demonstrated ability to lead knowledge transfer activities and provide guidance to junior analysts.


**Additional Notes**

* Your performance will support the successful delivery, adoption and ongoing reliability of eBusiness solutions that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, data quality and digital commerce capabilities.
* No relocation support is provided on the role.


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
   

  

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.

* On\-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.

b3f12245.title: Edge and IOT Architect
b3f12245.description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end architecture of enterprise IoT solutions covering edge computing, device connectivity, data ingestion, streaming, cloud platforms, data storage, analytics, APIs and user applications.
* Contribute to the architecture and development of reusable IoT platforms and solutions spanning Edge to Cloud.
* Design scalable, distributed and multi\-tenant SaaS platform architectures for IoT products and connected applications.
* Develop, test and integrate cloud Platform\-as\-a\-Service services to build applications accessible through web and mobile interfaces.
* Design and guide the implementation of cloud\-native applications and microservices on AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Define appropriate edge\-processing patterns, device\-management approaches, connectivity protocols and offline or intermittent\-connectivity strategies.
* Architect real\-time data\-ingestion and event\-streaming solutions using platforms such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis or Apache Pulsar.
* Design secure and high\-performing RESTful, event\-driven and public APIs for integration with devices, enterprise systems, partner platforms and third\-party applications.
* Work across product, engineering, data, security, DevOps and user\-experience teams to integrate platform components through well\-defined public and internal APIs.
* Define NoSQL and relational database architectures, including data modelling, indexing, partitioning, retention, performance and scalability considerations.
* Provide hands\-on architectural guidance for applications developed using .NET, Golang or Python and modern user\-interface frameworks such as React or Angular.
* Establish cloud\-infrastructure, observability, reliability, security, deployment and operational architecture standards.
* Define modern CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, automated\-testing and release\-management practices suitable for SaaS\-based product releases.
* Evaluate technology alternatives, undertake architecture trade\-off assessments and create reference architectures, solution blueprints and implementation roadmaps.
* Support technical discovery, solutioning, estimations, proposals, client workshops and architecture governance for strategic IoT and edge\-computing opportunities.
* Where applicable, design AI\-enabled IoT capabilities using retrieval\-augmented generation, machine learning and intelligent analytics architectures.


**Our Ideal Candidate**
* Extensive experience designing scalable, distributed and cloud\-native enterprise solutions or SaaS products.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end IoT architectures, including devices, gateways, edge computing, connectivity, telemetry ingestion, device management, cloud platforms and applications.
* Hands\-on experience architecting and building IoT applications and connected\-product platforms.
* Strong experience with cloud infrastructure and managed services on at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience with IoT services such as AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud\-based IoT patterns or equivalent enterprise IoT platforms.
* Strong understanding of edge\-computing architectures, local processing, protocol translation, remote management and edge\-to\-cloud integration.
* Experience with device and industrial communication protocols such as MQTT, AMQP, HTTP, OPC UA, Modbus or similar protocols.
* Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL database design, data modelling, indexing, partitioning and performance optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one event\-streaming or real\-time data platform such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis or Apache Pulsar.
* Strong professional experience developing applications using one or more of .NET, Golang or Python.
* Experience designing and implementing APIs for cloud\-native applications, including RESTful and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Familiarity with building rich web applications using React or Angular and integrating them with cloud\-based backend platforms.
* Good understanding of microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless computing and API\-management technologies.
* Familiarity with modern CI/CD, DevSecOps, infrastructure\-as\-code, automated testing and SaaS release\-management practices.
* Knowledge of cloud and IoT security, including device identity, certificate management, authentication, authorization, encryption and secure communications.
* Experience defining high\-availability, disaster\-recovery, observability, monitoring and operational\-support architectures.

c4899ebe.title: Technical Architect
c4899ebe.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Engage with Japanese\-speaking clients and stakeholders, leveraging Japanese language fluency to build trust and deliver effective communication in the Japan market
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* Business\-level Japanese language proficiency (written and spoken) — required for client\-facing engagements in the Japan market
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

29b86151.title: Technical Architect
29b86151.description:
**Department:** 
 Development
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Description**
 ParentPay Group is Europe’s leading software product company and the UK’s largest education technology business. We are on a mission to bring next\-generation innovation to positively impact on the lives of millions of parents, teachers, and students every day in over 49 countries.
   

  

 Our market leading products use cutting edge cloud\-based technology to streamline school processes, including secure web and mobile apps that enable secure online payments for school items such as meals, trips, clubs and uniform, improve parental engagement, simplify meal management and \- through our product SIMS \- collect and manage a database of student information and core school operations.
   

  

 ParentPay Group’s new offices in Pune are a fantastic tech hub for those looking to boost their careers in software product development.
   

  

 Our bright team FastTrack their career with international exposure and ways of working based on agile development best practices from globally renowned technology consultancies.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Driving outcomes: focuses on results and desired outcomes and how best to achieve them.
* Able to execute plans through to action. Persistent to complete tasks and a strong commitment to take action that moves things along to ensure delivery of objectives.
* Ownership \& accountability: takes personal accountability and ownership for their work. This includes personal follow through, making and defending difficult decisions and trade\-offs, removing blockers, driving collective progress.
* Continuous Improvement: advances by ongoing, incremental improvement through continuous learning, pair\-programming, questioning the status quo and trying out creative and novel ideas. Shows curiosity and has a keen interest to drive learning for themselves and others.
* Pragmatic in approach, understanding that software and its architecture are fundamentally about trade\-offs. What works today may not work tomorrow, evolutionary architecture is the goal.
* Truly full stack, from UI, Backend, DB, CI/CD to cloud infrastructure and IaC.
* Ability to work in a team of very experienced individuals, understands that egos are not productive, ability to listen and provide objective feedback.
* A lot more focus should be on leading by example and mentoring across all the teams to ensure that the team are successful within their remit.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

* Hands on experience of .NET Core, React, SQL and Azure.
* Experience with leading industry standard practices for software development and cloud infra such as DDD, TDD and deployment patterns (blue/green).
* Provide hands on technical leadership to the teams, resolve tech queries, ensure that the teams follow architectural principles/guidelines overall tech standards.
* Evaluate and improve the common platform components to help accelerate the programme.
* Actively participate in architectural governance forums such as centre of excellence (CoE) and technical guilds. Furthermore, ensure that decisions made are followed through within the teams.
* Work collaboratively with the Group Director of Technology, Head of Technology and fellow architects to influence and steer technical leads as well as their teams towards pragmatic decisions as well as communicate team progress.
* Undertake R\&D, prototype new approaches, technologies, techniques and ensure knowledge sharing to streams.

3bd933f3.title: Senior Architect
3bd933f3.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 We are seeking a GL29 Enterprise Print Architect to lead the technical architecture, modernization strategy, and future\-state design for enterprise print services. This role will provide architecture leadership across cloud\-based print management, secure print capabilities, endpoint integration, vendor platforms, infrastructure dependencies, and operational support models. The ideal candidate will bring solid enterprise architecture experience and the ability to translate business, security, operational, and technology requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and evolution of enterprise print architecture, including cloud\-based print management, secure print release, direct print, endpoint integration, and related infrastructure capabilities
* Develop future\-state architecture, technical roadmaps, standards, reference designs, and implementation patterns that align with enterprise technology, security, and operational strategies
* Partner with engineering, operations, security, network, endpoint, identity, vendor, and business teams to evaluate requirements, resolve dependencies, and guide solution decisions
* Assess current\-state print platforms, infrastructure, integrations, and support processes to identify modernization, automation, resiliency, cost optimization, and risk reduction opportunities
* Provide technical leadership for large\-scale migrations, acquired entity integrations, cloud transitions, vendor platform implementations, and print service expansion initiatives
* Evaluate vendor technologies and platform capabilities, including SaaS print management solutions, endpoint tools, APIs, reporting, monitoring, security controls, and automation opportunities
* Create and maintain architecture artifacts, decision records, technical documentation, diagrams, standards, and governance materials
* Influence technical direction across cross\-functional teams and communicate complex architecture topics clearly to technical teams, business partners, and senior leaders
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* 8\+ years of experience in enterprise, solution, infrastructure, platform, or systems architecture
* 5\+ years of experience designing, implementing, or supporting large\-scale enterprise technology solutions
* Experience developing technology roadmaps, architecture standards, future\-state solution designs, and technical decision recommendations
* Experience collaborating with engineering, security, operations, vendor, and business stakeholders in a complex enterprise environment
* Experience evaluating vendor solutions, comparing technical capabilities, and supporting technology selection decisions
* Solid knowledge of cloud, infrastructure, networking, identity, security, endpoint management, and enterprise platform technologies
* Demonstrated solid written, verbal, and executive\-level communication skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with enterprise print technologies such as PrinterLogic, Pharos, HP WebJet Admin, Zebra print management, or equivalent platforms
* Experience with Microsoft technologies including Azure, Entra ID, Intune, MECM/SCCM, Windows endpoint management, and related identity or device management capabilities
* Experience with SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations, automation, monitoring, reporting, and operational analytics
* Experience working in large, complex, highly regulated enterprise environments; healthcare technology experience
* Experience supporting technical governance, architecture review processes, security reviews, risk assessments, and standards development
* Experience designing resilient, scalable, secure, and supportable technology services across geographically distributed locations


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

988a27f6.description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
 At Presidio, we’re at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses—and their customers—to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
   

  

**The Role**
**Strategic Ownership \& Leadership**
* Own and manage the cloud ecosystem across AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring they operate with high efficiency, strong governance, and predictable costs.
* Lead a small team of cloud engineers, guiding and coaching them in roadmap creation, prioritization, execution, and skills development.
* Act as a strategic advisor to engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders on sandbox governance, usage patterns, and optimization strategies.
* Establish and enforce policies for onboarding, offboarding, resource lifecycle, and access management for users.


**Operational Excellence \& Automation**
* Design and implement automation for sandbox provisioning, quota management, access approval workflows, scheduling, and spin\-up/spin\-down processes.
* Develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Cloud\-native tools) for repeatable lab operations.\[MS1]
* Create self\-service capabilities and guardrails for sandbox users to reduce manual effort and improve governance.
* Collaborate on lab, demo, and proof of concept engagements with internal and external stakeholders.


**FinOps, Cost Governance \& Optimization**
* Implement a FinOps\-aligned operating model for all accounts including tagging standards, cost allocation, budget enforcement, and showback/chargeback across all clouds.
* Continuously analyze cloud spend trends, forecast usage, and proactively identify opportunities for rightsizing, decommissioning, and efficiency improvements.
* Build automation for policy\-based cleanup of unused/idle resources.


**Security, Governance \& Compliance**
* Define and implement security guardrails, baseline configurations, identity/access rules, and monitoring policies for sandbox environments.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance controls and enforce boundaries between sandbox and production environments.
* Implement monitoring dashboards, alerts, and operational metrics to ensure visibility and control.


**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively introduce new approaches, tools, and technologies to make lab and demo operations more efficient, secure, and cost\-effective.
* Conduct periodic reviews of account usage patterns to identify opportunities for consolidation, automation, or architectural improvements.
* Partner with cloud providers, vendors, and internal teams to evaluate new services and establish best practices.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud operations roles, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or team lead position.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and working knowledge of the other two.
* Demonstrated experience in managing large or multi\-tenant cloud environments, including governance, account/projects/subscription management.
* Strong automation experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Understanding of Cloud Networking Concepts, such as AWS VPCs, Transit Gateways, Azure VNets, Public DNS with AWS Route 53 and VPN tunnel creation from the hyperscaler side.
* Familiarity with Cloud Compute and Storage such as EC2 Instances, Azure Virtual Machines, Google Compute Engine, AWS S3/EBS/EFS and/or Azure Disk Storage
* Proven expertise in FinOps, cloud cost governance, and optimization frameworks.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, guardrails, monitoring, and policy management.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications: AWS Solutions Architect / Azure Architect Expert / GCP Professional Cloud Architect.
* Prior experience in managing demo or lab environments, platform engineering, or multi\-cloud landing zones.
* Experience with cost analytics tools (CloudHealth, Flexera, Cloud Custodian, Kubecost, native cost tools).
* Knowledge of container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD workflows.
* Exposure to Cloud Centers of Excellence (CCoE) or platform engineering teams.


**Your future at Presidio**
 Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers—thinkers, builders, and collaborators—who push the boundaries of what’s possible. With our expertise in AI\-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next\-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data\-driven transformation, you’ll be part of a team that is shaping the future.
   

  

**Ready to innovate? Let’s redefine what’s next—together.**
**About Presidio**
 At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades\-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio’s expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, enables actionable data insights and builds forward\-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally.
 **For more information, visit www.presidio.com** 
**.**
 Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.

 Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

4f02d856.title: Cloud & Virtualization Architect 14+years
4f02d856.description:
**Job Description**
 Role Overview As the Cloud \& Virtualization Architect, you will own the design and architecture of the enterprise virtualization platform (primarily Hyper\-V) and its hybrid\-cloud integration across a large\-scale environment. This is a senior architecture and engineering role — not an operations or day\-to\-day administration role. You will define how virtualization clusters are designed, sized, automated, and self\-healed, setting the standards and reference architectures that operations teams execute against. You will be the technical authority for cluster performance, capacity/right\-sizing, and infrastructure automation, solving the hardest platform\-level problems and driving the strategy rather than handling ticket queues. Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the design authority for the enterprise virtualization platform, primarily Hyper\-V (Failover Clustering, storage, and networking design)
* Architect virtualization clusters for performance, availability, and scale — including host standards, HA/failover design, and cluster topology
* Own capacity planning and right\-sizing across the fleet: node sizing, RAM/CPU/storage ratios, HA reservation models, and consolidation ratios grounded in real utilization data
* Design and drive infrastructure automation and orchestration using Ansible and Terraform — provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle as code
* Architect self\-healing infrastructure: automated detection and remediation of host, cluster, and VM health issues to reduce manual intervention
* Define reference architectures, design standards, and build/validate/release pipelines for virtualization hosts and templates
* Architect hybrid\-cloud and cloud integration (Azure preferred), including landing zone design, connectivity, and workload placement between on\-prem and cloud
* Establish performance baselines and observability standards for cluster health, capacity, and utilization; use data to guide design decisions
* Partner with compute, storage, network, and security teams to align virtualization design with hardening, compliance, and DR/BC requirements
* Provide senior\-level architecture guidance and root\-cause analysis for platform\-wide virtualization and performance issues; mentor engineers and set technical direction


**Qualifications**
 Required Skills \& Experience
   

  

* Deep expertise architecting enterprise virtualization at scale, with primary strength in Hyper\-V and Failover Clustering (VMware vSphere experience a plus)
* Proven experience with cluster performance engineering, capacity planning, and rightsizing across large fleets (thousands of VMs / hundreds of hosts)
* Strong automation and orchestration background: Terraform and Ansible for infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration management
* Experience designing self\-healing / auto\-remediation systems for infrastructure health and reliability
* Advanced PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and remediation
* Solid understanding of the underlying stack: compute, storage (SAN/NAS/S2D/vSAN), and networking as they relate to virtualization performance
* Hybrid\-cloud and public cloud architecture experience (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP relevant)
* Strong grasp of HA/DR design, live migration, and workload mobility
* Ability to operate as an architect: produce reference architectures and design documentation, set standards, and guide execution teams General Skills \& Competencies
* Proactive self\-starter who manages time and priorities independently
* Strong ability to translate business, performance, and capacity needs into comprehensive technical designs while building credibility across teams
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to deliver formal architecture presentations to technical teams and leadership
* Data\-driven decision\-maker who grounds design choices in utilization and performance metrics
* Mentors engineers, drives platform and process improvements, and keeps current with the virtualization and cloud landscape Experience Required
* 10\+ years in infrastructure engineering with a significant portion in a virtualization architecture or technical lead capacity on large\-scale environments
* Demonstrated ownership of cluster design, capacity/right\-sizing, and infrastructure automation (Ansible/Terraform) at scale

Is seen as a trusted advisor to mid\-level client touchpoints.  **SKILLS/COMPETENCIES REQUIRED FOR THE ROLE*** Develop proposal and execute projects.
* Problem Solving Ability
* Ability to work independently and on a team across multiple projects.
* Independent, proactive with solution thinking \& design
* People who have interest ranging from macroeconomics to MCU.
* Creative data junkies who enjoy solving impossible
* People with sharp analytical skills who can enthrall clients with stories.
* Willingness to stretch.
* Openness to travel
 **WHAT WE LOOK FOR**  

  

You bring a strong analytical ability but a ‘people\-focused’ approach as well as the ability to see things from an end\-user perspective. You will also have:* A strong passion for translating people data into meaningful insights that can ‘tell a story’,
* Intermediate to Advanced skillset with MS Excel and other MS office tools.

• Passion for driving results and focused on outcome and process.• Deal with immense ambiguity and navigate oneself from problem to the solution. **HOW WE SUPPORT OUR COLLEAGUES**  

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.  

Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!  

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant and more valued.

Overview:
**About The Company**
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000\+ employees and 24,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.  

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.  

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.  


In This Role, You Will::
**\# Leadership \& People Management\-*** AI first leader, should have actively contributed to business transformation initiatives within the organization.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of System Administrators and leaders, building a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Own hiring, onboarding, and capacity planning to scale the team while maintaining the quality.
* Set clear goals and development plans, conduct regular performance conversations, and manage performance to drive both individual growth and team outcomes.
* Identify and develop emerging leaders, building a strong succession pipeline within the team.

 **\# Strategy \& Operational Excellence\-**

* Develop and align the Professional Services strategy and operating model with company goals, priorities, and vision.
* Foster cross\-functional collaboration to drive product adoption, expansion, and successful client outcomes; influence and align stakeholders at all levels as a trusted advocate for the team.
* Use data and analytics to monitor performance, surface insights, lead data\-driven improvement initiatives, and drive data\-driven decision\-making.
* Create and present Business Reviews to senior and executive stakeholders, articulating performance, risks, and growth opportunities while representing the voice of the customer and team.
* Own financial and resource planning for the function, including budget definition, utilization, forecasting, and margin optimization, with reporting on costs and outcomes relative to departmental goals; exposure to P\&L management.
* Drive operational efficiency and resource utilization; and lead the team through change using change\-management practices to ensure adoption of new processes and ways of working.

**\# Customer Success \& Service Delivery\-**

* Act as a trusted advisor to strategic customers — staying engaged through regular check\-ins, owning internal and external escalations end to end (driving root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions), and ensuring continued value creation against each customer's business objectives.
* Build deep, foundational knowledge of the Cvent platform to guide the team and advise customers credibly.
* Gather internal and external feedback, translate it into actionable plans, and continuously raise customer satisfaction and retention.
* Document and track customer success stories and demonstrate return on investment (ROI) across the portfolio.

  


Here's What You Need::
* 12\+ years of overall experience in Professional Services, Technical Services, Consulting, Solution Architecture, Technical Account Management, Implementation, or related functions, preferably within a product or software (SaaS) company.
* 6\+ years of proven experience leading high\-performing teams including experience leading other leaders/managers.
* Demonstrated success building, scaling, and developing teams in a fast\-paced, customer\-facing environment.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills (verbal and written).
* Proven agility in a fast\-paced, constantly changing environment, with experience in program\-level financial and resource planning and budget tracking.
* Strong business acumen, data\-driven decision\-making, and the ability to translate insights into action.
* Bachelor’s degree is a must (Technology degree preferred); MBA is good to have.
* Experience with event technology platforms, and familiarity with Cvent, is an advantage.
* High integrity, strong ethics, and a collaborative, people\-first leadership style.

1fb6c111.title: AI Solutions Engineer
1fb6c111.description:
**About the role** 




 While you’re reading this, developers and enterprises across India are wiring Gnani’s speech APIs into their products — running ASR over noisy phone lines and generating TTS in a dozen Indian languages, in real time and at scale. You’re the person who makes that integration actually work: the first responder when accuracy dips, the engineer who turns a prospect’s “can it handle our audio?” into a working benchmark, and the technical voice the developer community hears back from.
 



 As an AI Solutions Engineer on our Speech API team, you sit between our ASR/TTS platform and the people building on it. You own the customer’s technical journey end\-to\-end — onboarding, accuracy validation, debugging, custom pipelines, and production quality — and you feed what you learn in the field straight back to the teams building the models. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing engineering role for someone early in their career who is technically sharp, obsessed with the customer, and communicates like a professional.
 



  





**Core mandate:** 




**Customer success \& onboarding** 




 Get prospects and customers live on the ASR/TTS APIs fast, and keep them successful
 



**Solutions \& custom engineering** 




 Design custom speech pipelines and integrations that fit enterprise needs
 



**Benchmarking \& quality** 




 Run customer and internal benchmarks; spot\-check production quality on a schedule
 



**Developer advocacy** 




 Be the technical face for the developer community and turn field signal into product feedback
 



  





**What you’ll drive** 
 :
 



**Customer onboarding \& support** 



* Own technical onboarding for prospects and customers — API integration, authentication, streaming vs. batch, sample code, and first\-call success
* Be the first responder on ASR/TTS issues — triage, reproduce, root\-cause, and resolve integration and accuracy problems
* Run accuracy checks with customers — set up test sets, interpret WER/CER for ASR and naturalness/MOS for TTS, and explain what the numbers actually mean
* Hand\-hold prospects through evaluation so they can reach a confident buying decision



**Solutions \& custom engineering** 



* Design and build custom speech solutions for enterprise clients — ASR/TTS configuration, custom vocabulary and pronunciation, and end\-to\-end pipelines
* Translate ambiguous customer requirements into concrete, working technical solutions and reference implementations
* Build demos, POCs, and sample integrations that show the platform at its best
* Partner with the ASR/TTS research and platform teams to shape features around real customer needs



**Benchmarking \& quality** 



* Run structured benchmarks — internal and customer\-supplied — across languages, accents, domains, and audio channels
* Design fair, honest evaluations: representative test sets, apples\-to\-apples comparison, and no overfitting to a single benchmark
* Perform periodic spot\-checks on production quality and flag regressions before customers do
* Turn recurring field failures into clear, reproducible reports the model teams can act on



**Developer experience \& community** 



* Be the technical, front\-facing voice for the developer community — docs, forums, sample code, and integration guides
* Gather developer feedback and channel it into the product roadmap
* Represent Gnani’s speech APIs in developer conversations and make the integration experience genuinely good to build on



**Who you are:** 




**EXPERIENCE WE’RE LOOKING FOR** 



* 2–3 years building speech / ML products, integrating APIs, or in a customer\-facing technical role (solutions, support, or field engineering)
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of: building an ASR, TTS, or speech\-related product; handling technical customers; or building custom solutions and integrations
* A track record of owning technical problems end\-to\-end and seeing them through to a working outcome
* Strong work ethic, high ownership, and comfort in a fast\-moving environment
* Customer\-obsessed, with clear and professional written and verbal communication



**WHAT MAKES A STANDOUT CANDIDATE** 



* Hands\-on with speech APIs — streaming and batch ASR, TTS, and real\-time audio integration
* Comfortable reading and writing integration code — Python plus at least one of REST / gRPC / WebSocket clients
* Familiarity with speech evaluation — WER / CER for ASR, naturalness / MOS for TTS, latency and RTF — and what they mean for a customer
* Understanding of audio fundamentals — sample rates, encodings, codecs, and telephony / contact\-centre audio
* Exposure to the Indian voice landscape — multilingual, code\-switched, and accented speech
* Experience writing developer\-facing docs, guides, or sample code



**TECHNICAL FLUENCY — GOOD TO HAVE** 



* Python for scripting demos, POCs, evaluation harnesses, and debugging
* API integration patterns — auth, streaming, retries, batching, and error handling
* Basic deployment literacy — cloud and on\-prem, containers, and how a speech service runs in production
* Familiarity with speech tooling and audio libraries, and the ability to pick up new ones fast
* Judgment on benchmark design — good test sets and fair comparison across languages, accents, domains, and channels.



  





**Why Gnani, why now:** 




 Gnani.ai is one of the few companies in India doing original speech research at depth — our ASR and TTS are trained on real Indian language data at scale, not adapted from English\-first systems. As an AI Solutions Engineer, you are the bridge between that technology and the developers and enterprises building on it: you’ll see your work land in production across banking, healthcare, logistics, and government services, and your field insight will directly shape what we build next.
 



 High ownership, high visibility, and a fast path to deep expertise in one of the most in\-demand areas of applied AI.
